Presentada con detalles de cómo a pasos e ilustraciones de color completo, la guía Nikon D5600 de David Busch para la fotografía digital cubre en profundidad todas las características de la cámara, desde tomar sus primeras fotos a través de detalles avanzados de configuración, exposición, selección de objetivos, iluminación y más, y relaciona cada característica con técnicas y situaciones fotográficas específicas. También está incluida la guía visual práctica de la D5600, con fotos de cerca y descripciones de las características y controles esenciales de la cámara, incluyendo la pantalla táctil LCD versátil. Aprenda cuándo utilizar cada opción y, más importante, cuando no utilizarlas, siguiendo los ajustes recomendados por el autor para cada entrada de menú. Con el fotógrafo más vendido y mentor David Busch como su guía, usted tendrá rápidamente el dominio creativo completo de las capacidades de su cámara, ya sea que usted está filmando en el trabajo, como un entusiasta avanzado, o simplemente están fuera para la diversión. Comience a construir su conocimiento y confianza, mientras que traer su visión a la luz con el Nikon D5600 hoy.

title: Canon EOS Rebel T6s / T6i (760D / 750D): From Snapshots to Great Shots
description: The Canon EOS T6i and T6s (known as the 760D and 750D outside of U.S.) are powerful new cameras intended for amateurs to semi-professionals who want to jump into photography with the control and capabilities of a DSLR. While the camera manual explains what the camera can do, it doesn’t show exactly how to use the camera to create great images! That’s where Canon EOS T6i / T6s: From Snapshots to Great Shots comes in. Starting with the top ten things users need to know about the camera, author Jeff Revell carefully guides readers through the operating features. Readers get practical advice from a pro on which settings to use when, great shooting tips, and end of chapter assignments. From Snapshots to Great Shots is a beautiful how-to photography series that provides the perfect blend of instruction, inspiration, and reference for specific camera models and photography concepts. Featuring a clear, elegant design; outstanding images that educate and inspire; and a friendly, accessible voice, this series helps photographers get great shots every time they pick up their camera. DP Review has strongly endorsed this new Rebel camera system, which represents a major upgrade from the T5i camera. Providing a complete body and lens system, both the T6i and T6s are made available as kits with zoom lenses, and include many feature upgrades, perhaps most significantly, a new 24.2MP APS-C CMOS sensor (up from 18MP on the T5i / 700D) coupled with a new 7560 pixel RGB + IR metering sensor for more accurate metering. Also, for the first time for the Rebel line, both cameras offer built-in Wi-Fi connectivity and NFC. Key T6i / T6s camera features: •    24.2MP APS-C CMOS sensor •    19-point autofocus system •    Hybrid CMOS AF III focus system (live view) •    7560 pixel RGB + IR metering sensor with skin tone detection •    3" fully articulating touchscreen LCD •    Eye sensor for use with optical viewfinder [T6s only] •    LCD information display on top plate [T6s only] •    Quick control dial on rear [T6s only] •    5 fps continuous shooting •    1080/30p video •    Servo AF in live view [T6s only] •    Wi-Fi with NFC

Mientras que el manual de cámara explica lo que la cámara puede hacer, no muestra exactamente cómo utilizar la cámara para crear grandes imágenes! Ahí es donde Canon EOS T6i / T6s: De las instantáneas a los grandes zapatos entra. Empezando con las diez mejores cosas que los usuarios necesitan saber sobre la cámara, el autor Jeff Revell guía cuidadosamente a los lectores a través de las funciones operativas. Los lectores reciben consejos prácticos de un profesional en los que los ajustes para usar cuando, grandes consejos de tiro, y final de asignaciones de capítulo. De Snapshots a Great Shots es una hermosa serie de fotografías que proporciona la combinación perfecta de instrucciones, inspiración y referencia para modelos de cámara específicos y conceptos de fotografía. Con un diseño claro y elegante; imágenes destacadas que educan e inspiran; y una voz amigable y accesible, esta serie ayuda a los fotógrafos a conseguir grandes tomas cada vez que recogen su cámara. DP Review ha respaldado firmemente este nuevo sistema de cámaras Rebel, que representa una mejora importante de la cámara T5i. Proporcionando un sistema completo de cuerpo y lentes, tanto los T6i como los T6 están disponibles como kits con lentes de zoom, e incluyen muchas actualizaciones de características, quizás lo más significativo, un nuevo sensor CMOS 24.2MP APS-C (hasta 18MP en el T5i / 700D) junto con un nuevo sensor de medición de 7560 píxeles RGB + IR para una medición más precisa. Además, por primera vez para la línea Rebel, ambas cámaras ofrecen conectividad Wi-Fi integrada y NFC. Características de la cámara T6i / T6s: • sensor CMOS 24.2MP • sistema de enfoque automático de 19 puntos • Sistema de enfoque híbrido CMOS AF III (vista en vivo) • sensor de medición de 7560 píxeles RGB + IR con detección de tonos de piel • pantalla táctil de 3" totalmente articuladora LCD • Sensor de ojos para uso con visor óptico [T6s solamente]

title: Using iMovie ’11
description: The Using series is not just a book; it is highly integrated with online video, audio, and additional bonus content that enables our authors to provide modern, best of class instruction to the beginning audience. Using books are designed to offer a solid and accessible introduction–both tutorial and reference-to a topic. The Using series is written in a succinct yet friendly manner and offers real-world advice and step by step tasks. Using iMovie ‘11 teaches you how to create Hollywood-level movies with ease. Beginning with tips on shooting your footage, to importing and organizing it, the authors then take the readers through all the steps of creating a finished movie, including editing, adding transitions, titles and special effects, making color corrections and video touchups, and adding and editing audio and sound effects. Then, after you have a completed movie, you'll learn how to share your movies with the world using iMovie's built in sharing features. In addition to the book's text, readers of Using iMovie '11 have unlimited access to exclusive media content including myriad videos and audio podcasts that show readers how to perform a task they just read about. These videos show readers an iMovie process (that is, trimming audio from a clip, adjusting your video's colors, and so on), so readers can see for themselves the process right on their screens–great if you're a visual learner. The podcasts also delve into additional subjects for the aspiring filmmaker, including tips on pre-production and how best to get your movie in front of your intended audience.
translatedDescription: La serie Usar no es sólo un libro; está altamente integrado con vídeo en línea, audio y contenido adicional de bonificación que permite a nuestros autores proporcionar la enseñanza moderna, mejor de clase a la audiencia inicial. Utilizar libros están diseñados para ofrecer una introducción sólida y accesible – ambos tutoriales y referencia a un tema. La serie Usar está escrita de una manera sucinta pero amistosa y ofrece consejos del mundo real y tareas paso a paso. Utilizando iMovie ‘11 te enseña cómo crear películas de Hollywood con facilidad. Comenzando con consejos sobre el rodaje de sus imágenes, para importarlas y organizarlas, los autores luego toman a los lectores a través de todos los pasos de crear una película terminada, incluyendo la edición, la adición de transiciones, títulos y efectos especiales, haciendo correcciones de color y video touchups, y la adición y edición de efectos de audio y sonido. Luego, después de tener una película completa, aprenderás a compartir tus películas con el mundo usando las funciones de compartir de iMovie. Además del texto del libro, los lectores de Utilizar iMovie '11 tienen acceso ilimitado al contenido exclusivo de los medios, incluyendo vídeos myriad y podcasts de audio que muestran a los lectores cómo realizar una tarea que acaban de leer. Estos vídeos muestran a los lectores un proceso iMovie (es decir, recortando audio de un clip, ajustando los colores de su vídeo, y así sucesivamente), por lo que los lectores pueden ver por sí mismos el proceso justo en sus pantallas – grande si usted es un estudiante visual. Los podcasts también se adentran en temas adicionales para el aspirante cineasta, incluyendo consejos sobre la preproducción y cómo obtener su película delante de su público previsto.

title: Creative Night: Digital Photography Tips & Techniques
description:
Take a well-timed shot in the dark with this invaluable guide to night photography

Shooting in low light and at night is challenging, but it can result in stunning images, so don't put that digital camera away after the sun goes down! Start capturing eerie and intriguing photographs at all levels of light with this information-packed guide from renowned photographer and author Harold Davis.

He provides pages of field-tested techniques to help you find the proper exposures, including the best settings for ISO, aperture, and shutter. Don't miss the intriguing examples of his own work, including cityscapes, landscapes, and more.

Walks readers through the intricacies of night and low light photography

Explores the fundamental rules of exposure, including creative settings for ISO, aperture, and shutter speeds

Informs and inspires with the author's own breathtaking examples of night photography, including cityscapes, landscapes, exciting night events, and other photos that illustrate the concepts

Capture the visually exciting world after the sun goes down with this essential guide to night photography.

Tomar un tiro bien hecho en la oscuridad con esta guía invaluable de la fotografía nocturna

Disparar en baja luz y por la noche es desafiante, pero puede resultar en imágenes impresionantes, así que no pongas esa cámara digital lejos después de que el sol caiga! Comience a capturar fotografías extrañas e intrigantes en todos los niveles de luz con esta guía llena de información del famoso fotógrafo y autor Harold Davis.

Proporciona páginas de técnicas de campo para ayudarle a encontrar las exposiciones adecuadas, incluyendo los mejores ajustes para ISO, apertura y obturación. No te pierdas los intrigantes ejemplos de su propio trabajo, incluyendo paisajes urbanos, paisajes y mucho más.

Camina a los lectores por las complejidades de la fotografía nocturna y baja luz

Informa e inspira con los propios ejemplos impresionantes de fotografía nocturna del autor, incluyendo paisajes urbanos, paisajes, eventos nocturnos emocionantes y otras fotos que ilustran los conceptos

Capturar el mundo visualmente emocionante después de que el sol baja con esta guía esencial de la fotografía nocturna.

title: Photographing Yosemite: Digital Field Guide
description:

Whether using a compact camera or a high-end dSLR, this companion guide provides you with detailed information for taking spectacular shots of some of the most recognizable landmarks in the world. Whether you aim to capture memorable photos of Half Dome, El Capitan, Vernal Fall, Mariposa Grove, or one of Yosemite's other many remarkable attractions, this portable resource goes where you go and walks you through valuable tips and techniques for taking the best shot possible.

You'll discover suggested locations for taking photos, recommended equipment, what camera settings to use, best times of day to photograph specific attractions, how to handle weather challenges, and more. In addition, beautiful images of Yosemite's most breathtaking attractions and recognizable landmarks serve to both inspire and assist you as you embark on an amazing photographic adventure!

Elevates your photography skills to a new level with photography secrets from professional photographer Lewis Kemper

Presents clear, understandable tips and techniques that span all skill levels, using all types of digital cameras, from compact cameras to high end DSLRs

Shares detailed information and insight on critical topics, such as ideal locations to photograph from, the best time of day to shoot, camera equipment to have handy, weather conditions, and optimal camera settings to consider

Whether you're a local familiar with the territory or a visitor seeing this beautiful U.S. National Park for the first time, this handy guide will help capture fantastic photos!

title: The Photoshop Elements 8 Book for Digital Photographers
description:
This book (for Windows and Mac) breaks new ground by doing something for digital photographers that’s never been done before—it cuts through the bull and shows you exactly “how to do it.” It’s not a bunch of theory; it doesn’t challenge you to come up with your own settings or figure things out on your own. Instead, it does something that virtually no other Elements book has ever done—it tells you flat-out which settings to use, when to use them, and why. If you’re looking for one of those “tell-me-everything-about-the-Unsharp-Maskfilter” books, this isn’t it. You can grab any other Elements book on the shelf, because they all do that. Instead, this book gives you the inside tips and tricks of the trade for organizing, correcting, editing, sharpening, retouching, and presenting your photos like a pro. You’ll be absolutely amazed at how easy and effective these techniques are—once you know the secrets. You’ll learn:

The real secrets of how the pros retouch portraits

How to color correct any photo without breaking a sweat (you’ll be amazed at how they do it!)

How to use Camera Raw for processing not only RAW photos, but JPEGs and TIFFs, too! (And you’ll learn why so many pros like it best— because it’s faster and easier)

The sharpening techniques the pros really use (there’s an entire chapter just on this!)

How to deal with common digital camera image problems, including removing noise and avoiding halos

The most requested photographic special effects,  and much more!

The Book's Secret Weapon Although Elements 8 offers some digital photography features that Photoshop CS4 doesn’t offer, there are plenty of features that Photoshop CS4 has that Elements 8 still doesn’t have (things like paths, Channel Mixer, etc.). But in this book, you’ll learn some slick workarounds, cheats, and some fairly ingenious ways to replicate many of those Photoshop features from right within Elements. Plus, since this book is designed for photographers, it doesn’t waste your time talking about how to frame a shot, setting your exposure, etc., and there’s no talk about which camera or printer to buy. It’s all Elements, step-by-step, cover-to-cover, in the only book of its kind!
translatedDescription:
Este libro (para Windows y Mac) rompe nuevo terreno haciendo algo para los fotógrafos digitales que nunca se ha hecho antes, corta el toro y te muestra exactamente “cómo hacerlo”. No es un montón de teoría; no te reta a venir con tus propios ajustes o a descubrir cosas por tu cuenta. En cambio, hace algo que prácticamente ningún otro libro de Elementos ha hecho nunca, te dice que los ajustes a utilizar, cuándo utilizarlos, y por qué. Si estás buscando uno de esos libros de "tell-me-todo-sobre-el-Unsharp-Maskfilter", esto no es todo. Puedes coger cualquier otro libro de Elementos en el estante, porque todos hacen eso. En su lugar, este libro le da los consejos y trucos interiores del comercio para organizar, corregir, editar, afilar, retocar y presentar sus fotos como un profesional. Te sorprenderá lo fácil y eficaz que son estas técnicas, ya que conoces los secretos. Aprenderás:

Los verdaderos secretos de cómo los pros retocan retratos

Cómo color corregir cualquier foto sin romper un sudor (se sorprenderá de cómo lo hacen!)

Cómo utilizar Camera Raw para procesar no sólo fotos RAW, sino también JPEGs y TIFFs! (Y aprenderás por qué tantos profesionales les gusta mejor, porque es más rápido y más fácil)

Las técnicas de afilado que los pros realmente usan (¡hay un capítulo entero justo en esto!)

Cómo lidiar con problemas comunes de imagen de cámara digital, incluyendo la eliminación de ruido y evitar halos

Los efectos especiales fotográficos más solicitados, y mucho más!

El arma secreta del libro Aunque Elementos 8 ofrece algunas características de fotografía digital que Photoshop CS4 no ofrece, hay un montón de características que Photoshop CS4 tiene que Elementos 8 todavía no tiene (cosas como caminos, Mezcla de Canal, etc.). Pero en este libro, usted aprenderá algunas rondas de trabajo slick, trampas, y algunas maneras bastante ingeniosas de replicar muchas de esas características de Photoshop de la derecha dentro de Elements. Además, ya que este libro está diseñado para fotógrafos, no pierde su tiempo hablando de cómo enmarcar un disparo, configurar su exposición, etc., y no hay ninguna charla sobre qué cámara o impresora comprar. ¡Son todos los Elementos, paso a paso, encubierto, en el único libro de su tipo!

title: Smart Business, Social Business: A Playbook for Social Media in Your Organization
description:
This book will help organizations evolve into a fully collaborative social business.  It serves as a step by step playbook to achieve organizational change, process efficiencies and technology acumen:

Proven solutions for the real people, process, and technology obstacles businesses face in using social media behind the firewall.

How to have the successful internal conversations with stakeholders, partners and global teams that lead to successful external conversations with the social customer

Strategies for improving organizational dynamics, collaboration, governance, training, engagement, policies, technology integration, workflows, social CRM, and metrics

Many organizations today have already evolved into social brands. They may be active on Twitter and Facebook; they may have corporate blogs and communities and they are trying hard to engage effectively with the social customer. However, behind the firewall, chaos, anarchy, and conflict reign. In Smart Business, Social Business, leading enterprise social business consultant shows how to build an internal framework based on change management that will lead to success with social media: one that will make external engagement more effective, meaningful, and sustainable. Michael Brito systematically identifies the internal culture, process and technology obstacles to long-term success with social media, and offer best practice solutions. He discusses a wide spectrum of issues, offering actionable intelligence and helping decision-makers build strategies and plans that deliver value. Topics addressed include change management, organizational models and dynamics, internal communications, collaboration, governance, metrics, training, employee activation, policies, technology integration, workflows, social CRM, and much more. Drawing on his own experience working for Silicon Valley companies, HP, Yahoo! and Intel, Brito presents dozens of examples and case studies. Using this book, companies can begin to transform their organizations from just a "social brand" to a fully collaborative and dynamic "social business.”
translatedDescription:
Este libro ayudará a las organizaciones a convertirse en un negocio social plenamente colaborativo. Sirve de libro de acción paso a paso para lograr el cambio de organización, la eficiencia de los procesos y la tecnología acumen:

Soluciones probadas para las personas reales, procesos y obstáculos tecnológicos que enfrentan las empresas en el uso de redes sociales detrás del cortafuegos.

Cómo tener conversaciones internas exitosas con actores, socios y equipos globales que conducen a conversaciones externas exitosas con el cliente social

Estrategias para mejorar la dinámica organizativa, la colaboración, la gobernanza, la capacitación, la participación, las políticas, la integración tecnológica, los flujos de trabajo, la CRM social y las métricas

Muchas organizaciones de hoy ya se han convertido en marcas sociales. Pueden estar activos en Twitter y Facebook; pueden tener blogs y comunidades corporativos y están tratando de comprometerse eficazmente con el cliente social. Sin embargo, detrás del cortafuegos, el caos, la anarquía y el conflicto reinan. En Smart Business, Social Business, el consultor principal de empresas sociales muestra cómo construir un marco interno basado en la gestión del cambio que dará lugar al éxito con las redes sociales: una que hará que el compromiso externo sea más eficaz, significativo y sostenible. Michael Brito identifica sistemáticamente los obstáculos de cultura, proceso y tecnología internos al éxito a largo plazo con las redes sociales y ofrece mejores soluciones de práctica. Habla de un amplio espectro de cuestiones, ofreciendo inteligencia práctica y ayudando a los encargados de adoptar decisiones a elaborar estrategias y planes que ofrezcan valor. Los temas abordados incluyen la gestión del cambio, modelos organizativos y dinámicas, comunicaciones internas, colaboración, gobernanza, métricas, capacitación, activación de los empleados, políticas, integración tecnológica, flujos de trabajo, CRM social y mucho más. Basándose en su propia experiencia trabajando para empresas Silicon Valley, HP, Yahoo! e Intel, Brito presenta docenas de ejemplos y estudios de casos. Utilizando este libro, las empresas pueden comenzar a transformar sus organizaciones de una "marca social" a una "empresa social" plenamente colaborativa y dinámica

title: Instructional Strategies and Techniques for Information Professionals
description:
Increasingly, library personnel are called upon to teach classes, deliver presentations and represent their organizations in an official capacity. This book is designed to assist those professionals with little to no experience designing and delivering training, instructional sessions, and presentations. Suitable for all librarians, library staff and library school students, this practical guide will get the library professional up and running as a trainer and presenter.
Written by practicing professional librarians and trainers for use in the library setting
Features a combination of training, facilitation, and public-speaking skills
Covers all aspects of training from audience evaluation to lesson plans to evaluation to lesson delivery

title: Adobe® GoLive® Classroom in a Book®
description: When you're ready to roll up your sleeves and start taking advantage of GoLive CS' powerful site management and collaboration capabilities, wireless authoring features, and dynamic database tools, it's time to get the guide from the people behind the software. In these pages, The Adobe Creative Team uses a series of project-based lessons to guide you through every aspect of GoLive's use. Working at your own pace, using training materials created and tested in Adobe's own classrooms and labs, you¿ll soon be creating effective, efficient Web sites with GoLive CS. Step-by-step instructions clearly detail toolbars, palettes, site architecture, Cascading Style Sheets, image maps, and more. And plenty of attention has been paid to GoLive CS' new features as well: enhanced Smart Object capabilities, advanced CSS authoring and previewing, streamlined print-to-Web production, and more. Each chapter concludes with a review section to reinforce what you've learned, and a CD-ROM provides the files and images needed to complete the exercises.

title: What Is Social Networking and Why Should You Care?
description:
This Element is an excerpt from 33 Million People in the Room: How to Create, Influence, and Run a Successful Business with Social Networking (9780137154357) by Juliette Powell. Available in print and digital formats.

Why social networking is far more important than you realize--even if you’re already actively involved in it.

When you look at history, the people who are changing the cultural, business, and scientific landscape are all connected to each other. In any era, the great artists and the brilliant scientists knew each other. They got together, inspired each other, collaborated together. Social networks make those relationships transparent, and provide tools to help you connect and stay connected...

Por qué las redes sociales son mucho más importantes de lo que te das cuenta, incluso si ya estás activamente involucrado en ello.

Cuando miras la historia, las personas que están cambiando el paisaje cultural, empresarial y científico están conectadas entre sí. En cualquier época, los grandes artistas y los brillantes científicos se conocían. Se juntaron, se inspiraron, colaboraron juntos. Las redes sociales hacen esas relaciones transparentes, y proporcionan herramientas para ayudarle a conectarse y mantenerse conectado...

title: Apple Pro Training Series: Making Basic Color Adjustments in Final Cut Pro X
description:

In this excerpt from Apple Pro Training Series: Final Cut Pro X Advanced Editing, you’ll learn how to prepare projects and set up the Final Cut Pro interface for color correction, how to use the built-in video scopes to analyze each clip—both technically and creatively—and how to use automatic tools along with manual Color Board adjustments to correct problems and enhance your program’s visuals. In the process, you’ll learn how to evaluate and adjust color and contrast for both utilitarian and creative effect.

title: Design and Deploy web sites with Macromedia® Dreamweaver® MX 2004 and Contribute® 3: Training from the Source

Through a series of project-based tutorials, Joseph shows you how to take advantage of the programs' shared check-in/check-out and versioning systems, integrated administration, and myriad other complementary features to create sophisticated, unbreakable sites that are a breeze for content creators and administrators alike. title: Compositing Visual Effects
description:
Put the essential concepts and techniques of digital compositing to work for you without the need of a single mathematical equation. Compositing Visual Effects is lavishly illustrated with hundreds of film shots, figures, illustrations and diagrams to help the visual reader gain a valuable vocabulary and understanding of the full range of visual effects, in which digital compositing plays a key role.

Beginning with an inspirational tour of the scope and magnitude of digital compositing you get a solid overview of the kinds of digital effects routinely executed today. See how CGI (Computer Generated Image) is composited with live action, how set extensions are done, and what a match-move shot is. Following that, you learn each of the key applications of digital compositing, which include bluescreen compositing, bullet time shots, motion tracking, and rotoscoping, and you get a primer on digital images, key concepts, and terms used in the compositing process. The subsequent chapters dig down into each of the major digital compositing applications, introducing the fundamental concepts and processes behind them. This includes the many ways to composite CGI, bluescreen compositing, animation, creating masks, working with digital keyers, and many more; but most importantly, the art of digital compositing-making your shots look not just photorealistic, but cool.

Learn what is easy and hard, possible and impossible, and what to expect when working on a job that entails digital compositing. There are tips on when not to use the new low-end DV video cameras and tips for the client, such as guidelines on how to shoot a quality bluescreen or greenscreen to get the best results at compositing time. All the while, special attention is paid to defining new terminology and telling a clear story from the ground up, with the only requirement being that you have read the previous chapters.
translatedDescription:
Poner los conceptos y técnicas esenciales de la composición digital para trabajar para usted sin la necesidad de una sola ecuación matemática. Compositing Visual Effects está ilustrado con cientos de filmes, figuras, ilustraciones y diagramas para ayudar al lector visual a obtener un valioso vocabulario y comprensión de toda la gama de efectos visuales, en los que la composición digital juega un papel clave.

Comenzando con un recorrido inspirador del alcance y la magnitud de la composición digital, se obtiene una visión sólida de los tipos de efectos digitales ejecutados rutinariamente hoy. Vea cómo CGI (Imagen Generada en Computador) se compone de acción en vivo, cómo se hacen extensiones de conjunto, y qué es un disparo de movimiento de coincidencias. Después de eso, usted aprende cada una de las aplicaciones clave de la composición digital, que incluyen compositing de pantalla azul, disparos de tiempo de bala, seguimiento de movimiento y rotoscoping, y usted consigue una imprenta en imágenes digitales, conceptos clave y términos utilizados en el proceso de composición. Los capítulos posteriores profundizan en cada una de las principales aplicaciones de composicion digital, introduciendo los conceptos y procesos fundamentales detrás de ellos. Esto incluye las muchas maneras de componer CGI, compositing de pantalla azul, animación, crear máscaras, trabajar con keyers digitales, y muchos más; pero lo más importante, el arte de compositing digital que sus tomas parecen no sólo fotorealistas, sino frescos.

Aprenda qué es fácil y difícil, posible e imposible, y qué esperar cuando se trabaja en un trabajo que implica la composición digital. Hay consejos sobre cuándo no utilizar las nuevas cámaras de video DV de gama baja y consejos para el cliente, tales como directrices sobre cómo disparar una pantalla azul de calidad o una pantalla verde para obtener los mejores resultados en tiempo de componer. Mientras tanto, se presta especial atención a definir nueva terminología y contar una historia clara desde el suelo, con el único requisito de que haya leído los capítulos anteriores.

title: The Essential Guide to Physics for Flash Games, Animation, and Simulations
description:
Physics for Flash Games, Animation, and Simulations teaches ActionScript programmers how to incorporate real physics into their Flash animations, games, user interfaces, and simulations.

Introduces Flash physics in an accurate, but approachable way, covering what is required to produce physically realistic simulations (as opposed to animations that look roughly right)

Packed full of practical examples of how physics can be applied to your own games and applications

Addresses the diverse needs of game developers, animators, artists, and e-learning developers

The book assumes a basic knowledge of ActionScript and Flash. However, no previous knowledge of physics is required—only some very basic math skills. The authors present everything from basic principles to advanced concepts, so you'll be able to follow the logic and easily adapt the principles to your own applications. The book builds on your physics knowledge, enabling you to create not only visual effects, but also more complex models and simulations.

What you'll learn

Basic math and physics you'll need to incorporate realism into your games, animations and simulations

How to incorporate a wide range of forces, including environmental forces such as gravity and friction, and forces due to fluids, such as drag and upthrust

How to build a number of realistic simulations, like submarines and flight simulators

How to model particle systems and use them for generative art and to create effects, such as smoke

Numerical subtleties, including accuracy and stability of integration schemes and handling boundary conditions properly; and how and when to use approximations and analytical solutions

Who this book is for

Flash developers interested in incorporating real physics into their games, animations, simulations or generative art projects.
translatedDescription:
Física para Flash Games, Animation y Simulations enseña a los programadores de ActionScript cómo incorporar la física real en sus animaciones Flash, juegos, interfaces de usuario y simulaciones.

Presenta la física Flash de una manera precisa, pero accesible, cubriendo lo que se requiere para producir simulaciones físicamente realistas (a diferencia de las animaciones que parecen aproximadamente correctas)

Empaquetado lleno de ejemplos prácticos de cómo la física se puede aplicar a sus propios juegos y aplicaciones

Aborda las diversas necesidades de desarrolladores, animadores, artistas y desarrolladores de aprendizaje electrónico

El libro asume un conocimiento básico de ActionScript y Flash. Sin embargo, no se requiere ningún conocimiento previo de la física, sólo algunas habilidades matemáticas muy básicas. Cómo construir una serie de simulaciones realistas, como submarinos y simuladores de vuelo

Cómo modelar los sistemas de partículas y utilizarlos para el arte generativo y crear efectos, como el humo

Desarrolladores Flash interesados en incorporar física real en sus juegos, animaciones, simulaciones o proyectos de arte generativo.

The book goes well beyond the program's features list to demystify the entire process of DVD design and authoring.Author Marc Loy, who has been using DVD Studio Pro since its inception, goes beyond a simple discussion about the DVD Studio Pro 3 interface and entices readers to experience the program's powerful capabilities as they create eye-catching, innovative DVD designs. He covers the actual protocols involved with the DVD files and filesystems, pixel aspect ratio issues, and common "gotchas" using both still and motion media. He also delivers plenty of tips and tricks for using dynamic buttons. DVD Studio Pro 3: In the Studio explores most everything you need and want to know, including importing from Photoshop and Final Cut Pro, making motion video menus available, effective looping of video and audio, adding multilingual menus and subtitles, encoding rules for DVDs, scripting, and mass duplication hunts.DVD Studio Pro 3: In the Studio is a professional-level book for anyone who's serious about creating high-impact, professional-level DVDs to make your unique vision a digital video reality.

description:

Co-written by Tim O'Reilly and Sarah Milstein, widely followed and highly respected twitterers, the practical information in The Twitter Book is presented in a innovative, visually rich format that's packed with clear explanations and examples of best practices that show Twitter in action, as demonstrated by the work of over 60 twitterers.

Tim O Reilly (@timoreilly), founder and CEO of O Reilly Media, has hundreds of thousands of followers on Twitter. Sarah Milstein (@SarahM) frequently writes, speaks and teaches about Twitter; she was the 21st user of Twitter.

title: Welcome to Oz: A Cinematic Approach to Digital Still Photography with Photoshop
description:
"Vincent Versace is a Renaissance man who has produced the best how-to book of the year! With its subtitle of “A Cinematic Approach to Digital Still Photography with Photoshop” Versace introduces a system for creating images that owes as much to the traditional darkroom as the digital one. Don’t just read the book; study it. The first chapter isn’t called “The Tao of Dynamic Workflow” for nothing and, like the rest of the book, contains Versace’s charm, wit, and wisdom. It’s copiously illustrated with detailed step-by-step examples of techniques that when applied to your own work will turn you from zero to hero. The fact that he’s a heck of a photographer means the book is stunningly illustrated, but it’s also been well designed. It has become a cliché to say that a book could change your life, but this one could." -- Joe Farace, December, 2007 , Shutterbug,  Top Digital Books Of 2007; More & Better Digital Imaging Books Creating memorable photographs is a process that starts before you edit an image in Photoshop, before you capture the image, even before you pick up the camera. You must first approach the subject with the proper sense of perception, with the ability to visualize the finished print before you commit a scene to pixels, but still be flexible and spontaneous. Master Fine Art photographer Vincent Versace has spent his career learning and teaching the art of perception and how to translate it into stunning images. In Welcome to Oz,  he delves into what it means to approach digital photography cinematically, to use your perception, your camera, and Photoshop to capture the movement of life in a still image.

 Adapt your workflow to the image so you always know how best to use your tools

 Turn a seemingly impossible photographic scenario into a successful image

 Practice “image harvesting” to combine the best parts of  many captures to create an optimum final result

 Create black and white prints that have the look, feel and “richness” of traditional silver prints without ever leaving the RGB color space

No sólo lea el libro; estúbelo. El primer capítulo no se llama “El Tao del flujo de trabajo dinámico” por nada y, como el resto del libro, contiene el encanto, ingenio y sabiduría de Versace. Se ha convertido en un cliché para decir que un libro podría cambiar su vida, pero éste podría". -- Joe Farace, diciembre, 2007 , Shutterbug, Top Digital Books Of 2007; Más & Mejores Libros de Imágenes Digitales Crear fotografías memorables es un proceso que comienza antes de editar una imagen en Photoshop, antes de capturar la imagen, incluso antes de recoger la cámara. Combining tons of illustrations and example Web pages with concise, easy-to-follow how-tos, authors Towers, Hadjitarkhani, and Magee make it easy for anyone to create a dynamic Web site using Dreamweaver-including you!

Esta valiosa referencia recoge donde la Guía Visual QuickStart deja fuera con tutoriales avanzados paso a paso en el servicio de página dinámica, gestión del sitio y creación de páginas dinámicas básicas, y eso es sólo en la primera mitad del libro! La segunda mitad del libro incluye instrucciones claras y concisas sobre cómo crear diseños complejos de página, construir menús de cascada y barras de herramientas, utilizar las funciones de accesibilidad de Dreamweaver, y configurar una página con etiquetas de cabeza para atraer motores de búsqueda. A lo largo de esta referencia basada en tareas, los autores ilustran características clave con ejemplos reales de cómo y cuándo deben usarse las características. description:
Macromedia FreeHand MX: Training from the Source  is a thorough ground-up text  that is part of  the popular series from Macromedia Press.  Macromedia FreeHand MX leads you step-by-step through  the program's most important new features as you work through several, practical graphic design projects that reflect real-world problems, solutions, and practices.

The book's project-based tutorial approach allows you to work through the lessons in the book at your own pace, using the practice files on the companion CD-ROM to get started immediately with the program!

title: Dividends & Interest: Drawing on Leadership
description: That was pretty much the extent of my awareness of David—until he found out through a third party that I was a frustrated cartoonist. From that day on he saw me as one of his inner circle, and that was an interesting place to be. David required me to provide a regular output of cartoon drafts. He was the ultimate encouraging coach. He always found something he liked about my amateurish attempts and made me feel good about the work I had done. He might have added a line here or suggested a different background there, but always with a light touch, and he never tried to alter my idea for a cartoon. He also challenged me to do better and kept talking about my stack of scribblings as my portfolio. After David critiqued my work I always felt motivated to do more.
translatedDescription: Ese fue el alcance de mi conciencia sobre David, hasta que descubrió a través de un tercero que yo era un caricaturista frustrado. A partir de ese día me vio como uno de su círculo interior, y ese era un lugar interesante para ser. David me pidió que proporcionara una salida regular de dibujos animados. Era el último entrenador alentador. Siempre encontró algo que le gustaba de mis intentos aficionados y me hizo sentir bien con el trabajo que había hecho. Podría haber añadido una línea aquí o sugerir un fondo diferente allí, pero siempre con un toque ligero, y nunca trató de alterar mi idea para un dibujo animado. También me desafió a hacerlo mejor y siguió hablando de mi pila de garabatos como mi cartera. Después de que David criticara mi trabajo siempre me sentí motivada para hacer más.

title: You’ve Released a Successful New Product...Now What?
description:
This Element is an excerpt from From Concept to Consumer: How to Turn Ideas Into Money (9780137137473) by Phil Baker. Available in print and digital formats.

  

What to do after you get your product to market: preparing for competition, extending your advantage, and preparing your “next act.”

After coming up with a product idea, raising money, building a team, engineering the product, shepherding it through manufacturing, and finding and negotiating with partners, can you find time to relax? Perhaps for a long weekend. Having a successful product attracts a lot of attention—not just from customers, but also from competitors around the world….
translatedDescription:
Este Elemento es un extracto de From Concept to Consumer: How to Turn Ideas Into Money (9780137137473) de Phil Baker. Disponible en formatos impresos y digitales.



Qué hacer después de que usted consigue su producto al mercado: prepararse para la competencia, ampliar su ventaja, y preparar su "acto siguiente".

Después de venir con una idea de producto, recaudar dinero, construir un equipo, ingeniería del producto, pastorearlo a través de la fabricación, y encontrar y negociar con los socios, ¿puede encontrar tiempo para relajarse? Quizás durante un largo fin de semana. Tener un producto exitoso atrae mucha atención, no sólo de clientes, sino también de competidores de todo el mundo....

description: Need to learn iPhoto 6 fast? Try a Visual QuickStart! Best-selling author and instructor Adam Engst uses crystal-clear instructions, full-color illustrations, and friendly prose to introduce you to everything from importing, tagging, editing, and perfecting images to creating slideshows and photo albums to easy online Web publishing. You’ll also learn about everything new in iPhoto 6, including enhanced editing and special effects, calendars and cards, photocasting, and more!

title: Nikon Lenses: From Snapshots to Great Shots
description:
You own a Nikon DSLR, but which Nikon (Nikkor) lens is best for your shooting style and your budget? This guide by pro photographer Jerod Foster will help you learn the features of Nikon lenses to capturevthe stunning pictures you want for a price that matches your needs.

Foster starts with the basics of using lenses in the Nikon lineup–from kit, to prime, to wide angle, to telephoto, to zoom, and more. Whether it’s portraits, landscapes, sports, travel, or night photography, you will have a better understanding of the different Nikon lenses and your choices for investing in them. In this guide you will:

Master the key camera features that relate to lenses–depth of field, perspective, and vibration reduction

Learn the difference between full frame versus cropped sensors and how they affect specific lenses

Understand best practices for maintaining your lenses and for taking better pictures

Accessorize your Nikon lenses with lens rigs, extenders, and other add-on equipment

Minimize lens flaws such as distortion and chromatic aberration in post processing with Lightroom

Grasp all the concepts and techniques as you go, with assignments at the end of every chapter

Beautifully illustrated with large, compelling photos, this book for beginning-to-intermediate digital photographers will help you get the image you want every time you pick up your camera. And once you have the shot, show it off and join the book’s flickr group: www.flickr.com/groups/nikonlenses_fromsnapshotstogreatshots.
translatedDescription:
Usted posee un Nikon DSLR, pero ¿qué lente Nikon (Nikkor) es mejor para su estilo de tiro y su presupuesto? Esta guía del fotógrafo profesional Jerod Foster le ayudará a aprender las características de las lentes Nikon para capturar las impresionantes imágenes que desea por un precio que coincida con sus necesidades.

Foster comienza con los fundamentos del uso de lentes en la alineación Nikon – desde el kit, hasta el ángulo principal, hasta el telefoto, para ampliar, y más. Ya sea retratos, paisajes, deportes, viajes o fotografía nocturna, usted tendrá una mejor comprensión de los diferentes lentes Nikon y sus opciones para invertir en ellos. En esta guía usted:

Dominar las características clave de la cámara que se relacionan con lentes – profundidad de campo, perspectiva y reducción de vibraciones

Aprenda la diferencia entre el marco completo versus los sensores recortados y cómo afectan las lentes específicas

Comprenda las mejores prácticas para mantener sus lentes y para tomar mejores imágenes

Accede a sus lentes Nikon con plataformas de lente, extensores y otros equipos adicionales

Minimizar defectos de lente como la distorsión y la aberración cromática en el procesamiento post con Lightroom

Aplique todos los conceptos y técnicas a medida que vaya, con asignaciones al final de cada capítulo

Hermoso ilustrado con fotos grandes y convincentes, este libro para fotógrafos digitales de principio a intermediario te ayudará a conseguir la imagen que quieras cada vez que recojas tu cámara. Y una vez que tengas la oportunidad, enséñala y únete al grupo del libro: www.flickr.com/groups/nikonlenses desnapshotstogreatshots.

title: Learn Adobe Dreamweaver CC for Web Authoring

A mix of project-based lessons, practical videos, and regular assessments throughout prepares you for an entry-level position in a competitive job market.

Adobe conducted research to identify the foundational skills students need to effectively communicate using digital media tools. Based on feedback from educators, design professionals, businesses, and educational institutions around the world, the objectives cover entry-level skill expectations for each topic. The ACA exams have proved to be highly successful; Adobe reports that the total number of exams taken worldwide has reached one million since 2008.

title: A Digital Photographer's Guide to Model Releases: Making the Best Business Decisions with Your Photos of People, Places and Things
description: Do you need a release for a photo of someone you took in public? How about photos of buildings? Does it make a difference if the subject was paid to be in the picture? You can't answer these questions without more information. As the photographer, you need to understand your buyer's concerns in order to make savvy decisions about how you market your photos and to whom. Here's how to make money from all your photos, whether or not they have releases, by understanding the business aspects of the law.

title: Lifelike Heads
description:
Learn to draw amazingly realistic portraits in seven easy stages

This book is the perfect guide for creating lifelike representations of the human head in graphite. Experienced artist Lance Richlin begins by explaining drawing tools and materials, shading techniques, and the important anatomical structures of the head. Following these basics, he shows how to light the subject, block in and render each feature of the face, and address a variety of expressions-from subtle smiles to toothy grins. Then he guides the reader through four impressive projects, showing how to develop a lifelike head drawing in seven simple stages: the lay-in, plumb lines, volume, outline, tonal pattern, value, and finishing. Readers also will find an in-depth troubleshooting section to help them identify and solve any problems that lessen the realism and accuracy of their drawings. In an age full of technological shortcuts, this book emphasizes drawing from life and seeks to preserve the methods of the old masters.
translatedDescription:
Aprende a dibujar retratos increíblemente realistas en siete etapas fáciles

Este libro es la guía perfecta para crear representaciones de la cabeza humana en grafito. El artista experimentado Lance Richlin comienza explicando herramientas de dibujo y materiales, técnicas de afeitado y las importantes estructuras anatómicas de la cabeza. Siguiendo estos fundamentos, muestra cómo iluminar el sujeto, bloquear y renderizar cada característica de la cara, y abordar una variedad de expresiones-de sonrisas sutiles a sonrisas dentadas. Luego guía al lector a través de cuatro proyectos impresionantes, mostrando cómo desarrollar un dibujo de cabeza de estilo vital en siete etapas simples: la construcción, líneas de fontanería, volumen, contorno, patrón tonal, valor y acabado. Los lectores también encontrarán una sección de solución de problemas en profundidad para ayudarles a identificar y resolver cualquier problema que menoscabe el realismo y la precisión de sus dibujos. En una época llena de atajos tecnológicos, este libro enfatiza el aprovechamiento de la vida y busca preservar los métodos de los antiguos maestros.

title: The Wedding Video Handbook
description: For readers who want to become part of the thriving wedding video industry, Wedding Video Handbook explains everything a wedding videographer needs to know. Each chapter explores a different part of either the business or the production ends, and covers topics including secrets for getting clients, selecting the proper equipment, and tips on capturing special wedding moments despite difficult filming conditions. The book includes handy primers on marketing and advertising, handling phone calls and appointments, pre-production preparations, what to shoot on the wedding day, interacting with other vendors, editing and packaging the DVD or video, and generating referrals. Fully up-to-date with information on the newest tools and equipment used in this rapidly-evolving market as well as the cutting-edge trends in wedding video products, Wedding Video Handbook is packed with practical advice from a pro who has spent years in the field.
translatedDescription: Para los lectores que quieren formar parte de la próspera industria de vídeo de la boda, Wedding Video Handbook explica todo lo que un videografo de la boda necesita saber. Cada capítulo explora una parte diferente del negocio o la producción termina, y cubre temas incluyendo secretos para conseguir clientes, seleccionando el equipo adecuado, y consejos para capturar momentos especiales de boda a pesar de difíciles condiciones de filmación. El libro incluye manuales sobre marketing y publicidad, manejo de llamadas telefónicas y citas, preparaciones previas a la producción, qué grabar en el día de la boda, interactuar con otros proveedores, editar y empaquetar el DVD o vídeo, y generar referencias. Completamente actualizado con información sobre las herramientas y el equipo más nuevos utilizados en este mercado de rápido desarrollo, así como las tendencias de vanguardia en los productos de vídeo de la boda, Wedding Video Handbook está lleno de consejos prácticos de un profesional que ha pasado años en el campo.

title: The Art of Flash Animation: Creative Cartooning
description: Part animation guide, part Flash manual, The Art of Flash Animation: Creative Cartooning provides a practical primer on classic, hand-drawn 2D screen animation as well as an introduction to using Flash for creating your own cartoons. Section I discusses the terms and techniques of hand-drawn animation, character design, and storyboards, while Section II covers scanning, digitizing your artwork into Flash, and setting up scenes.Topics include how to animate a walk cycle; recording and editing dialogue, sound effects, and music; how to use recyclable symbols to make the animation process more efficient; preparing your work for video or web download.

La sección I discute los términos y técnicas de animación dibujada a mano, diseño de personajes y guiones de cuentos, mientras que la sección II cubre el escaneo, digitalizando su obra en Flash, y estableciendo escenas. Los temas incluyen cómo animar un ciclo de caminata; grabación y edición de diálogo, efectos de sonido y música; cómo utilizar símbolos reciclables para hacer más eficiente el proceso de animación; preparación de su trabajo para descargar vídeo o web.

title: Choosing Scope Over Focus
description: Digital technology has already upended the media and information sectors. It’s about to do the same to the manufacturing economy, and pave the way for what can be called the “pan-industrial” strategy.

title: Social Media Branding For Small Business
description: Social media branding provides the thinking, evidence, and practice to create a road map for practitioners in small businesses to develop and implement their brand in online and of ine communities. It provides a starting point, as one of the biggest issues for small businesses is where to start. Social Media Branding For Small Businesses provides a framework to guide your strategy and implementation. The approach is called the 5-Sources Model. The resources are the have fundamental branding principles that focus on simply outsourcing your brand. Putting the customer back in control while focusing on the community and this group of dedicated customers and other stakeholders. The 5-Sources Model simply says that the social media brand for small businesses needs to play an important role in your customers’ functional and emotional existence. It is both the serious and the fun experience of your brand.

Proporciona un punto de partida, ya que uno de los mayores problemas para las pequeñas empresas es donde empezar. Marca de redes sociales para pequeñas empresas proporciona un marco para guiar su estrategia y aplicación. El enfoque se llama el modelo 5-Fuerzas. Los recursos son los principios fundamentales de marca que se centran en simplemente externalizar su marca. Poner al cliente de nuevo en control mientras se centra en la comunidad y este grupo de clientes dedicados y otros interesados. El modelo 5-Fuerzas simplemente dice que la marca de redes sociales para las pequeñas empresas tiene que desempeñar un papel importante en la existencia funcional y emocional de sus clientes. Es la experiencia seria y divertida de tu marca.

title: Make Your Business Social
description:
In this book, readers will find the inspiration needed to expand social media presence and add an appealing new dimension to branding and marketing efforts.

Social media has exploded, not only for individuals but for businesses too. Today, more than 83% of small business owners say they believe social media is essential for their companies. In this book you will learn how to: build or expand a social media audience for your business; create graphics, even if you’re not a designer; choose the right platforms for your business; cultivate strategies for present and future social media; and use real-life experience from current business owners.

title: The EDCF Guide to Digital Cinema Production
description:
A professional introduction to the end-to-end process of digital filmmaking!

The EDCF Guide to Digital Cinema Production sheds light on the ongoing and confusing transition from analog to digital technology in film production. In addition to a complete analysis of technical concerns, this text deals with a number of issues where European and Hollywood priorities differ. It adds fuel to the discussion on "Photo-Chemical Fundamentalism" and the future of traditional film-based cinematography.

With special emphasis on new HD production techniques for the big cinema screen, this guide is the one and only resource available from a European perspective. The EDCF Guide to Digital Cinema Production provides film professionals and decisions-makers in European cinema with an excellent basis for discussions on how to handle the transition from analog to digital technology.

Look no further for:

* Several production case studies, among them Ingmar Bergman's last film "Saraband" (2003) and Lars von Trier's "Dogville" (2003).

* Surveys of HD Systems & Cameras and "The 37 MFAQ on HD Production."

* Expert reports on Audio Recording for HD and the Digital Intermediate Process.

* Detailed European initiatives in Digital Cinema.

* An up-to-date survey of the problematic standards situation for Digital Cinema.

* A comprehensive look at archiving - the "Achilles Heel" of digital production.

* The pros and cons of producing feature films digitally - a unique and professional view of "the agony and ecstacy."

Editor-in-Chief Lasse Svanberg is a founding member of EDCF. He was DoP on 14 feature films 1966-81, founded TM (Technolgy & Man) Magazine at the Swedish Film Institute in 1968 and was its Chief Editor until 1998 He was elected Fellow of BKSTS 1979, Fellow of SMPTE 1995 and granted Professor's title by the Swedish Government 2002. He is the author of six books on the history and possible future of film, video and television.

The European Digital Digital Cinema Forum (EDCF) was constituted in June 2001 as joint Swedish-British-French effort to establish a European forum for discussions, information exchange and industrial activities in the field of Digital Cinema. This project was initiated because digital production, digital distribution and digital exhibition of film is the most radical technical change facing the film industry since sound film was introduced.
translatedDescription:
¡Una introducción profesional al proceso de final a final de cine digital!

La Guía EDCF para la Producción Digital de Cine arroja luz sobre la transición continua y confusa de la tecnología analógica a la digital en la producción cinematográfica. Además de un análisis completo de las preocupaciones técnicas, este texto aborda una serie de cuestiones en las que las prioridades europeas y de Hollywood difieren. Añade combustible a la discusión sobre el " Fundamentalismo Fotoquímico" y el futuro de la cinematografía tradicional cinematográfica.

Con especial énfasis en nuevas técnicas de producción HD para la gran pantalla de cine, esta guía es el único recurso disponible desde una perspectiva europea. La Guía EDCF para la Producción Digital de Cine proporciona a los profesionales del cine y a los responsables de las decisiones del cine europeo una excelente base para las discusiones sobre cómo manejar la transición de la tecnología analógica a la digital.

No busques más para:

* Varios estudios de casos de producción, entre ellos la última película de Ingmar Bergman "Saraband" (2003) y "Dogville" de Lars von Trier (2003).

* Encuestas de Cámaras de Sistemas HD y "El 37 MFAQ en Producción HD".

* Informes de expertos sobre Grabación de audio para HD y el Proceso Intermedio Digital.

* Iniciativas europeas detalladas en Cine Digital.

* Una encuesta actualizada sobre la situación de las normas problemáticas para el cine digital.

* Una mirada integral al archivado - el "Achilles Heel" de la producción digital.

* Los pros y contras de la producción digital de largometrajes - una visión única y profesional de "la agonía y el éxtasis".

Editor en Jefe Lasse Svanberg es miembro fundador de EDCF. Fue DoP en 14 largometrajes 1966-81, fundó TM (Technolgy & Man) Magazine en el Swedish Film Institute en 1968 y fue editor jefe hasta 1998 Fue elegido Fellow of BKSTS 1979, Fellow of SMPTE 1995 y concedió el título del profesor por el Gobierno sueco 2002. Es autor de seis libros sobre la historia y posible futuro de cine, vídeo y televisión.

El European Digital Cinema Forum (EDCF) se constituyó en junio de 2001 como un esfuerzo conjunto sueco-británico-francés para establecer un foro europeo para discusiones, intercambio de información y actividades industriales en el campo del cine digital. Este proyecto se inició porque la producción digital, la distribución digital y la exposición digital del cine es el cambio técnico más radical que enfrenta la industria cinematográfica desde que se introdujo la película sonora.

title: Humanize: How People-Centric Organizations Succeed in a Social World
description:
A practical guide for realizing the true potential of social media—not for marketing, but for leadership.

Knowing the tools of social media is a must for successful marketing these days, but the real promise of social media is the way it can teach us a whole new way of doing business. Humanize takes the principles underlying social media’s growth and applies them to the way we lead and manage our organizations. Leading organizational consultants Jamie Notter and Maddie Grant help you change your organization, from the culture down to individual behavior, in ways that make it more human—and more effective. Drawing on their extensive experience, Notter and Grant help you make management innovation real and doable. Regardless of your title or position, this book can help you:

·         Build a more trustworthy, open, generative, and courageous organization by embracing social and human principles.

·         Change organizations from the inside out.

·         Address critical elements of organizational behavior, process, and culture.

·         Move beyond the social media buzzwords like transparent, decentralized, and open—and actually make them happen.

·         Promote forms of “generative” success that go beyond profit and loss.

·         Learn how to get started–you, personally, today, right now!

Humanizar toma los principios subyacentes del crecimiento de las redes sociales y los aplica a la forma en que lideramos y administramos nuestras organizaciones. Los principales consultores organizativos Jamie Notter y Maddie Grant le ayudan a cambiar su organización, desde la cultura hasta el comportamiento individual, de maneras que lo hacen más humano y más eficaz. Basándose en su amplia experiencia, Notter y Grant le ayudan a hacer que la innovación de gestión sea real y factible. Independientemente de su título o posición, este libro puede ayudarle:

· Promover formas de éxito “generativo” que vayan más allá del beneficio y la pérdida.

Move from theory to practice and build sustainable business success.

title: Master Handbook of Acoustics, Sixth Edition, 6th Edition
description:
The most complete and current guide to architectural acoustics principles and practices

Design and construct audiophile-quality sonic environments of all sizes--from home theaters and project studios to large-scale recording studios. title: Handbook of Usability Testing: How to Plan, Design, and Conduct Effective Tests, Second Edition
description: Whether it's software, a cell phone, or a refrigerator, your customer wants-no, expects-your product to be easy to use. This fully revised handbook provides clear, step-by-step guidelines to help you test your product for usability. Completely updated with current industry best practices, it can give you that all-important marketplace advantage: products that perform the way users expect. title: Effective DevOps
description:
Some companies think that adopting devops means bringing in specialists or a host of new tools. With this practical guide, you’ll learn why devops is a professional and cultural movement that calls for change from inside your organization. Authors Ryn Daniels and Jennifer Davis provide several approaches for improving collaboration within teams, creating affinity among teams, promoting efficient tool usage in your company, and scaling up what works throughout your organization’s inflection points.

Devops stresses iterative efforts to break down information silos, monitor relationships, and repair misunderstandings that arise between and within teams in your organization. By applying the actionable strategies in this book, you can make sustainable changes in your environment regardless of your level within your organization.

Explore the foundations of devops and learn the four pillars of effective devops
Encourage collaboration to help individuals work together and build durable and long-lasting relationships
Create affinity among teams while balancing differing goals or metrics
Accelerate cultural direction by selecting tools and workflows that complement your organization
Troubleshoot common problems and misunderstandings that can arise throughout the organizational lifecycle
Learn from case studies from organizations and individuals to help inform your own devops journey

title: Building Enterprise-Ready Azure Infrastructure: Learn Security, Scalability, and Reliability with IaC & DevOps
description:
Cloud infrastructure is the backbone of modern enterprises, and Azure is at the forefront of delivering secure, scalable, and resilient cloud solutions. However, building enterprise-grade Azure infrastructure goes beyond provisioning virtual machines and storage it requires a deep understanding of architecture best practices, security frameworks, automation, and cost optimization. This book provides a technical deep dive into designing, automating, and securing Azure environments, making it an essential guide for cloud architects, DevOps engineers, and enterprise IT professionals.

Through real-world insights, hands-on coding examples, and best practices, readers will learn to automate infrastructure with Terraform and Bicep, secure workloads with Zero Trust principles, design highly available multi-region architectures, and optimize costs with Azure Monitor. The book also covers networking, disaster recovery, Kubernetes (AKS), CI/CD pipelines, and compliance frameworks, ensuring a comprehensive approach to Azure infrastructure management. Packed with real-world case studies from industries like finance, healthcare, and SaaS, this guide bridges the gap between theory and practical implementation, empowering professionals to build, secure, and optimize Azure environments at an enterprise scale.

You Will:

Design robust, high-availability architectures using Availability Zones, Traffic Manager, and geo-redundant strategies for disaster recovery

Seamlessly integrate Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), container registries, and CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps for streamlined deployment

.
Implement strong governance, proactive monitoring, and cost optimization using Azure Policy, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics

This book is for : Cloud architects, DevOps engineers, and enterprise IT professionals.

La infraestructura de la nube es la columna vertebral de las empresas modernas, y Azure está a la vanguardia de ofrecer soluciones seguras, escalables y resilientes en la nube. Sin embargo, la construcción de infraestructura Azure de grado empresarial va más allá de la provisión de máquinas virtuales y almacenamiento que requiere una comprensión profunda de las mejores prácticas de arquitectura, marcos de seguridad, automatización y optimización de costos. Este libro proporciona una profunda inmersión técnica en el diseño, automatización y seguridad de entornos Azure, lo que lo convierte en una guía esencial para arquitectos en la nube, ingenieros DevOps y profesionales de TI empresarial.

A través de ideas reales, ejemplos de codificación práctica y mejores prácticas, los lectores aprenderán a automatizar la infraestructura con Terraform y Bicep, cargas de trabajo seguras con principios Zero Trust, diseñar arquitecturas de multiregión altamente disponibles y optimizar costos con Azure Monitor. El libro también incluye redes, recuperación en casos de desastre, Kubernetes (AKS), tuberías CI/CD y marcos de cumplimiento, asegurando un enfoque integral de la gestión de infraestructuras Azure. Envasado con estudios de casos reales de industrias como finanzas, salud y SaaS, esta guía reduce la brecha entre la teoría y la implementación práctica, capacitando a profesionales para construir, asegurar y optimizar entornos Azure a escala empresarial.

Lo harás:

Diseño de arquitecturas robustas y de alta disponibilidad utilizando Zonas de disponibilidad, gerente de tráfico y estrategias geo-redundantes para la recuperación de desastres

Integrar sin problemas el servicio Azure Kubernetes (AKS), los registros de contenedores y los oleoductos CI/CD con Azure DevOps para un despliegue simplificado

.
Implementar una gobernanza sólida, monitoreo proactivo y optimización de costes utilizando Azure Policy, Azure Monitor y Log Analytics

Este libro es para: Arquitectos en la nube, ingenieros de DevOps y profesionales de TI empresarial.

title: Domain-Driven Design with Golang
description:
This book serves as a comprehensive guide to applying Domain-driven Design (DDD) principles using the Go programming language. By reading this book, you'll develop a deep understanding of DDD concepts and how to effectively implement them in real-world solutions. You'll also work through building a domain-driven monolithic application and a microservice.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the core concepts of Domain-driven Design, including bounded contexts and value objects.
Gain hands-on experience with Go-specific implementations of DDD patterns like aggregates and repositories.
Learn how to model and manage complex business domains in software systems.
Apply DDD principles to both monolithic and microservice architectures.
Develop scalable, maintainable systems by leveraging resilient design patterns.

Author(s)

Matthew Boyle is an experienced software developer with a track record of building robust, scalable systems using Golang and Domain-driven Design principles. He has a passion for creating readable and maintainable codebases, blending theory with practical application. Drawing from his professional experience, Boyle provides actionable insights and teaches readers how to adopt DDD practices.

Who is it for?

This book is designed for software developers and engineers who are familiar with the Go programming language and want to deepen their understanding of Domain-driven Design. It's suitable for intermediate Go developers aiming to write maintainable code while delivering clear business value. If you're looking to learn how DDD can be applied and integrated into Go-based projects, this book offers valuable insights.

También trabajará mediante la construcción de una aplicación monolítica impulsada por dominio y un microservicio.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Entender los conceptos básicos del diseño impulsado por dominio, incluyendo contextos consolidados y objetos de valor.
Obtenga experiencia práctica con las implementaciones Go-specific de patrones DDD como agregados y repositorios.
Aprende a modelar y gestionar dominios empresariales complejos en sistemas de software.
Aplicar principios de DDD a arquitecturas monolíticas y microservicio.
Desarrollar sistemas escalables y sostenibles aprovechando patrones de diseño resistentes.

Matthew Boyle es un desarrollador de software experimentado con un historial de construcción de sistemas robustos y escalables utilizando los principios de diseño impulsados por Golang y Domain. Este libro está diseñado para desarrolladores de software e ingenieros que están familiarizados con el lenguaje de programación Go y quieren profundizar su comprensión del diseño impulsado por Domain. title: Architecting AWS with Terraform

"Architecting AWS with Terraform" is a beginner-to-advanced guide to mastering the use of Terraform for developing scalable, secure infrastructure on AWS. What this Book will help me do

Understand Terraform frameworks, providers, and modules to build your AWS infrastructure.
Learn to automate deploying AWS projects with Terraform and continuous integration workflows.
Gain insights into best practices and enterprise-grade governance for Terraform projects.
Implement serverless and containerized AWS applications with Terraform.
Build secure and manageable AWS workloads utilizing Terraform capabilities.

Author(s)

Erol Kavas, a seasoned cloud architect and an AWS-certified expert with over a decade of experience, brings a practical, hands-on approach to mastering Terraform on AWS. Leveraging his experience in architecting complex infrastructure projects, he ensures concepts are clearly explained and examples are practical, catering to both beginners and seasoned professionals.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for cloud architects, DevOps engineers, and developers who are responsible for managing and automating AWS workloads. If you are familiar with AWS concepts and are looking to implement Infrastructure as Code practices and automate recurring tasks, this book is perfect for you.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para arquitectos en la nube, ingenieros de DevOps y desarrolladores responsables de gestionar y automatizar las cargas de trabajo de AWS. title: Domain-Driven Design with Java - A Practitioner's Guide
description:
"Domain-Driven Design with Java - A Practitioner's Guide" offers practical insights into leveraging Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles to tackle complex software problems. You will gain a deeper understanding of concepts such as bounded contexts, event sourcing, and microservices architectures, empowering you to build reliable, scalable, and maintainable software systems.

What this Book will help me do

Gain a clear understanding of the core principles of Domain-Driven Design.
Learn how to collaboratively model domains using techniques such as Event Storming and domain storytelling.
Master the implementation patterns using frameworks and Java tools for domain models.
Develop an ability to architect microservices with DDD tactical patterns such as bounded contexts and aggregates.
Understand how to design and build testable, extendable, and resilient distributed systems with event-driven architectures.

Author(s)

Premanand Chandrasekaran and Karthik Krishnan are seasoned software engineers and architects who specialize in building modern, efficient, and user-centric software solutions. With extensive experience in applying Domain-Driven Design and modern architectural principles, they bring a practical, hands-on perspective to software development. Their combined expertise ensures a detail-oriented yet easy-to-follow methodology for exploring DDD in Java.

Who is it for?

This book is tailored for Java developers and software architects who are looking to deepen their knowledge and application of Domain-Driven Design. It is ideal for individuals with a foundational understanding of programming in Java, seeking to learn collaborative techniques for software modeling. Readers who aim to build distributed systems and scalable architectures while incorporating event-driven design principles will find this book especially beneficial.

title: DevOps for the Desperate
description:
If you’re a software engineer, developer, or sys admin who needs to get up to speed with DevOps quickly, this book covers the basics you need to thrive in a modern application stack.

This book’s fast-paced, hands-on examples will provide the foundation you need to start performing common DevOps tasks. You’ll explore how to implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management (CM)—essential practices for designing secure and stable systems. You’ll take a tour of containerization and set up an automated continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline that builds, tests, and deploys code. You’ll dig into how to detect a system’s state and alert on it when things go sideways.

You’ll learn how to:

•Create and provision an Ubuntu VM with Vagrant and Ansible •Manage users, groups, and password security •Set up public key and two-factor authentication over SSH •Automate and test a host-based firewall •Use Docker to containerize applications and Kubernetes for orchestration •Build a monitoring stack and troubleshoot problems and performance issues

DevOps for the Desperate is a practical, no-nonsense guide to get you up and running quickly in today’s full-stack infrastructure.
