title: DTrace: Dynamic Tracing in Oracle
description:
The first guide to DTrace: the breakthrough debugging tool for Mac OS X, Unix, Solaris, and OpenSolaris operating systems and applications

Complete coverage: architecture, implementation, components, usage, and much more

Covers integrating DTrace into open source code, and integrating probes into application software

Includes full chapter of advanced tips and techniques

For users of DTrace on all platforms

Foreword by Bryan Cantril, creator of DTrace

 DTrace represents a revolution in debugging. Using it, administrators, developers, and service personnel can dynamically instrument operating systems and applications to quickly ask and answer virtually any question about how their operating systems or user programs are behaving. Now available for Solaris 10 and OpenSolaris, Mac OS X, and FreeBSD, thousands of professionals are discovering DTrace - but, until now, there's been no comprehensive, authoritative guide to using it. This book fills that gap. Written by four key contributors to the DTrace community, it's the first single source reference to this powerful new technology. The authors cover everything technical professionals need to know to succeed with DTrace, regardless of the operating system or application they want to instrument. The book also includes a full chapter of advanced tips and techniques.

Cobertura completa: arquitectura, implementación, componentes, uso y mucho más

Cubre la integración de DTrace en código fuente abierto, e integración de sondas en software de aplicaciones

Incluye capítulo completo de consejos y técnicas avanzadas

Para usuarios de DTrace en todas las plataformas

Prefacio de Bryan Cantril, creador de DTrace

DTrace representa una revolución en depuración. Utilizarlo, administradores, desarrolladores y personal de servicio pueden instrumentar dinámicamente sistemas operativos y aplicaciones para hacer y responder rápidamente cualquier pregunta sobre cómo se comportan sus sistemas operativos o programas de usuario. Ahora disponible para Solaris 10 y OpenSolaris, Mac OS X, y FreeBSD, miles de profesionales están descubriendo DTrace - pero, hasta ahora, no ha habido una guía completa y autorizada para usarla. Este libro llena esa brecha. Escrito por cuatro contribuyentes clave a la comunidad DTrace, es la primera referencia única a esta poderosa nueva tecnología. title: Honeypots: Tracking Hackers
description:
"The text is comprehensive, an honest survey of every honeypot technology I had ever heard of and a number I read about for the first time." --Stephen Northcutt, The SANS Institute

"One of the great byproducts of Lance's work with honeypots and honeynets is that he's helped give us a much clearer picture of the hacker in action." --From the Foreword by Marcus J. Ranum

"From the basics of shrink-wrapped honeypots that catch script kiddies to the detailed architectures of next-generation honeynets for trapping more sophisticated bad guys, this book covers it all....This book really delivers new information and insight about one of the most compelling information security technologies today." --Ed Skoudis, author of Counter Hack, SANS instructor, and Vice President of Security Strategy for Predictive Systems

Honeypots are unique technological systems specifically designed to be probed, attacked, or compromised by an online attacker. Implementing a honeypot provides you with an unprecedented ability to take the offensive against hackers. Whether used as simple "burglar alarms," incident response systems, or tools for gathering information about hacker motives and tactics, honeypots can add serious firepower to your security arsenal.

Honeypots: Tracking Hackers is the ultimate guide to this rapidly growing, cutting-edge technology. The book starts with a basic examination of honeypots and the different roles they can play, and then moves on to in-depth explorations of six specific kinds of real-world honeypots: BackOfficer Friendly, Specter™, Honeyd, Homemade honeypots, ManTrap®, and Honeynets.

Honeypots also includes a chapter dedicated to legal issues surrounding honeypot use. title: Android Forensics
description:
Android Forensics: Investigation, Analysis, and Mobile Security for Google Android provides the background, techniques and analysis tools you need to effectively investigate an Android phone. This book offers a thorough review of the Android platform, including the core hardware and software components, file systems and data structures, data security considerations, and forensic acquisition techniques and strategies for the subsequent analysis require d. this book is ideal for the classroom as it teaches readers not only how to forensically acquire Android devices but also how to apply actual forensic techniques to recover data.

The book lays a heavy emphasis on open source tools and step-by-step examples and includes information about Android applications needed for forensic investigations. It is organized into seven chapters that cover the history of the Android platform and its internationalization; the Android Open Source Project (AOSP) and the Android Market; a brief tutorial on Linux and Android forensics; and how to create an Ubuntu-based virtual machine (VM). The book also considers a wide array of Android-supported hardware and device types, the various Android releases, the Android software development kit (SDK), the Davlik VM, key components of Android security, and other fundamental concepts related to Android forensics, such as the Android debug bridge and the USB debugging setting. In addition, it analyzes how data are stored on an Android device and describes strategies and specific utilities that a forensic analyst or security engineer can use to examine an acquired Android device.

Core Android developers and manufacturers, app developers, corporate security officers, and anyone with limited forensic experience will find this book extremely useful. It will also appeal to computer forensic and incident response professionals, including commercial/private sector contractors, consultants, and those in federal government.

Named a 2011 Best Digital Forensics Book by InfoSec Reviews
Ability to forensically acquire Android devices using the techniques outlined in the book
Detailed information about Android applications needed for forensics investigations
Important information about SQLite, a file based structured data storage relevant for both Android and many other platforms.

title: Understanding Motion Capture for Computer Animation, 2nd Edition
description:
Understanding Motion Capture for Computer Animation discusses the latest technology developments in digital design, film, games, medicine, sports, and security engineering. Motion capture records a live-motion event and translates it into a digital context. It is the technology that converts a live performance into a digital performance. In contrast, performance animation is the actual performance that brings life to the character, even without using technology. If motion capture is the collection of data that represents motion, performance animation is the character that a performer represents.

The book offers extensive information about motion capture. It includes state-of-the-art technology, methodology, and developments in the current motion-capture industry. In particular, the different ways to capture motions are discussed, including using cameras or electromagnetic fields in tracking a group of sensors. This book will be useful for students taking a course about digital filming, as well as for anyone who is interested in this topic.

Completely revised to include almost 40% new content with emphasis on RF and Facial Motion Capture Systems
Describes all the mathematical principles associated with motion capture and 3D character mechanics
Helps you budget by explaining the costs associated with individualized motion capture projects

En contraste, la animación de rendimiento es el rendimiento real que trae vida al personaje, incluso sin utilizar la tecnología. Si la captura de movimiento es la recopilación de datos que representa el movimiento, la animación de rendimiento es el personaje que representa un intérprete.

title: Success in Programming: How to Gain Recognition, Power, and Influence through Personal Branding
description:
Why should you, a competent software developer or programmer, care about your own brand? After all, it’s not like you're an actor or musician.

In fact, as Success in Programming: How to Gain Recognition, Power, and Influence Through Personal Branding demonstrates in many ways, it’s never been more important for you to think about yourself as a brand. Doing so will provide rocket fuel for your career. You’ll find better jobs and become the ""go-to"" person in various situations. You’ll become known for your expertise and leadership, and you'll find it easier to strike out on your own. People will seek out your advice and point of view. You’ll get paid to speak, write, and consult. What’s not to like about becoming a rock star developer?

The good news—as Mozilla’s senior technology evangelist, Frédéric Harper, writes—is that it’s never been easier to improve your skills, stand out, share more quickly, and grow your network. This book provides the tools you need to build your reputation and enhance your career, starting right now. You'll learn what personal branding is and why you should care about it. You’ll also learn what the key themes of a good brand are and where to find the ingredients to build your own, unique brand. Most importantly, you'll understand how to work your magic to achieve your goals and dreams. You’ll also learn:

How to use sites like StackOverflow and Github to build both your expertise and your reputation
How to promote your brand in a way that attracts better-paying jobs, consulting gigs, industry invitations, and contract work
How to become visible to the movers and shakers in your specific category of development
How to exert power and influence to help yourself and others

Success in Programming: How to Gain Recognition, Power, and Influence Through Personal Branding shows you how to scale your skills, gain visibility, make a real impact on people and within organizations, and achieve your goals. There’s no need to become a marketing expert or hire a personal branding guru; this book and a desire to grow personally and professionally are all you need to leap to the next level of your career.

David Busch's Canon EOS R8 Guide to Digital Photography is your all-in-one comprehensive resource and reference for the exciting new Canon EOS R8, which is aimed squarely at enthusiasts looking for an affordable full-frame entry to mirrorless photography. 

It boasts a 24.2 sensor with superior low-light performance and action-friendly 40 frames-per second continuous shooting capabilities. Advanced video features include 4K and HDR video, and 10-bit C-log3 capture for sophisticated color grading. 

Three available adapters make it easy to supplement your RF-mount lenses with a broad selection of legacy Canon EF and EF-S optics. The R8 also features wireless connectivity to computers and smart devices. With this book in hand, you can quickly apply all these advanced features to your digital photography, while boosting your creativity to take great photographs with your Canon EOS R8.

Filled with detailed how-to steps and full-color illustrations, David Busch's Canon EOS R8 Guide to Digital Photography covers all this upscale camera's features in depth, from taking your first photos through advanced details of setup, exposure, lens selection, lighting, and more, and relates each feature to specific photographic techniques and situations. Also included is the handy "roadmap" chapter, an easy-to-use visual guide to the cameras' features and controls. Learn when to use each option and, more importantly, when not to use them, by following the author’s recommended settings for every menu entry. With best-selling photographer and mentor David Busch as your guide, you'll quickly have full creative mastery of your camera’s capabilities, whether you're shooting on the job, as an advanced enthusiast, or are just out for fun. Start building your knowledge and confidence, while bringing your vision to light with the Canon EOS R8.

title: Remote Usability Testing
description:
Remote usability testing is a key approach for understanding user behavior in diverse geographic and temporal contexts. This book offers a comprehensive guide to conducting remote usability studies, focusing on both moderated and unmoderated methodologies. You will learn to design, execute, and analyze these studies, all while leveraging their cost-effectiveness and flexibility.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the different methodologies for remote usability testing and their unique advantages.
Gain skills in planning and preparation for remote studies, ensuring clear objectives and effective execution.
Learn best practices for recruiting participants for remote usability testing.
Master the specifics of moderating and structuring a remote study, adapting approaches for remote settings.
Analyze and present meaningful study results to inform design improvements.

Author(s)

Inge De Bleecker and None Okoroji are renowned professionals in the field of user experience and usability testing. With years of experience in conducting user studies and improving user interfaces, they bring practical insights into remote usability testing. Their approachable writing and actionable advice make this book an invaluable resource for UX practitioners.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for user experience (UX) professionals who want to add remote usability testing to their skills toolkit. It is well-suited for those familiar with traditional usability testing methods, as well as beginners looking to enter the field. Additionally, product managers and customer experience professionals looking to leverage usability research for informed decisions will find this guide useful.

Aprenderás a diseñar, ejecutar y analizar estos estudios, mientras aprovechas su eficacia en función de los costos y flexibilidad.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Comprender las diferentes metodologías para la prueba de usabilidad remota y sus ventajas únicas.
Obtención de habilidades en la planificación y preparación de estudios remotos, asegurando objetivos claros y una ejecución efectiva.

Inge De Bleecker y Ninguno Okoroji son reconocidos profesionales en el campo de la experiencia de usuario y pruebas de usabilidad. Además, los gestores de productos y los profesionales de la experiencia del cliente que buscan aprovechar la investigación de usabilidad para decisiones informadas encontrarán útil esta guía.

Embracing new processes such as biomimicry, they bridge the gap between art, design, technology, and sustainability more than any other material. title: Designing Gestural Interfaces
description:
If you want to get ahead in this new era of interaction design, this is the reference you need. Nintendo's Wii and Apple's iPhone and iPod Touch have made gestural interfaces popular, but until now there's been no complete source of information about the technology. Designing Gestural Interfaces provides you with essential information about kinesiology, sensors, ergonomics, physical computing, touchscreen technology, and new interface patterns -- all you need to know to augment your existing skills in "traditional" web design, software, or product development. Packed with informative illustrations and photos, this book helps you:

Get an overview of technologies surrounding touchscreens and interactive environments
Learn the process of designing gestural interfaces, from documentation to prototyping to
communicating to the audience what the product does
Examine current patterns and trends in touchscreen and gestural design
Learn about the techniques used by practicing designers and developers today
See how other designers have solved interface challenges in the past
Look at future trends in this rapidly evolving field

Only six years ago, the gestural interfaces introduced in the film Minority Report were science fiction. Now, because of technological, social, and market forces, we see similar interfaces deployed everywhere. Designing Gestural Interfaces will help you enter this new world of possibilities.

Wii de Nintendo y iPhone y iPod Touch de Apple han hecho las interfaces gesturales populares, pero hasta ahora no ha habido una fuente completa de información sobre la tecnología. El diseño de interfaces gesturales le proporciona información esencial sobre kinesiología, sensores, ergonomía, computación física, tecnología de pantalla táctil y nuevos patrones de interfaz, todo lo que necesita saber para aumentar sus habilidades existentes en el diseño web "tradicional", software o desarrollo de productos. Envasado con ilustraciones y fotos informativas, este libro te ayuda:

Obtenga una visión general de las tecnologías que rodean pantallas táctiles y entornos interactivos
Aprende el proceso de diseño de interfaces gesturales, desde documentación hasta prototipado hasta
comunicar a la audiencia lo que hace el producto
Examine patrones y tendencias actuales en pantalla táctil y diseño gestural
Aprende sobre las técnicas utilizadas por diseñadores y desarrolladores practicantes hoy
Vea cómo otros diseñadores han resuelto problemas de interfaz en el pasado
Mira las tendencias futuras en este campo en rápida evolución

Hace sólo seis años, las interfaces gesturales introducidas en la película Minority Report eran ciencia ficción. Ahora, debido a las fuerzas tecnológicas, sociales y de mercado, vemos interfaces similares desplegadas en todas partes. Diseñar interfaces geográficas le ayudará a entrar en este nuevo mundo de posibilidades.

title: Placing the Suspect Behind the Keyboard
description:
Placing the Suspect Behind the Keyboard is the definitive book on conducting a complete investigation of a cybercrime using digital forensics techniques as well as physical investigative procedures. This book merges a digital analysis examiner's work with the work of a case investigator in order to build a solid case to identify and prosecute cybercriminals.

Brett Shavers links traditional investigative techniques with high tech crime analysis in a manner that not only determines elements of crimes, but also places the suspect at the keyboard. This book is a first in combining investigative strategies of digital forensics analysis processes alongside physical investigative techniques in which the reader will gain a holistic approach to their current and future cybercrime investigations.

Learn the tools and investigative principles of both physical and digital cybercrime investigations—and how they fit together to build a solid and complete case
Master the techniques of conducting a holistic investigation that combines both digital and physical evidence to track down the "suspect behind the keyboard"
The only book to combine physical and digital investigative techniques
translatedDescription:
Colocar el sospechoso detrás del teclado es el libro definitivo sobre la realización de una investigación completa de un delito cibernético utilizando técnicas forenses digitales y procedimientos de investigación física. Este libro fusiona el trabajo de un examinador de análisis digital con el trabajo de un investigador de caso para construir un caso sólido para identificar y procesar a los cibercriminales.

Brett Shavers vincula técnicas de investigación tradicionales con análisis de delitos de alta tecnología de manera que no sólo determina elementos de crímenes, sino que también coloca al sospechoso en el teclado. Este libro es el primero en combinar estrategias de investigación de procesos de análisis forense digital junto con técnicas de investigación física en las que el lector obtendrá un enfoque holístico de sus investigaciones actuales y futuras de cibercrimen.

Aprenda las herramientas y los principios de investigación de las investigaciones físicas y digitales de cibercrimen, y cómo encajan para construir un caso sólido y completo
Máster en las técnicas de realización de una investigación holística que combina evidencia digital y física para rastrear el "suspecto detrás del teclado"
El único libro para combinar técnicas de investigación física y digital

title: The Art of Drawing Folds
description:
From Renaissance fresco painters to contemporary graphic novelists, the ability to draw clothed figures from one’s imagination has always been crucial to artists – and exceptionally difficult to attain. With over 220 illustrations, The Art of Drawing Folds: An Illustrator’s Guide to Drawing the Clothed Figure reveals the logic and patterns in folds, enabling the reader to more easily predict the behavior of cloth when creating folds in their own drawings and paintings.

Addressing folds in clothing systematically, the author provides a clear, concise approach to the analysis, classification and visualization of convincingly naturalistic folds. Starting with the nature of fabric and its geometry, this book methodically explores the reasons for fold behavior based on the construction of clothing and the shapes and actions of the human figure. An essential guide and reference for animators, illustrators, storyboard artists, comic book artists, 3D modelers, sculptors, fashion designers and students, The Art of Drawing Folds simplifies one of the most complex and important aspects of drawing the clothed figure.
translatedDescription:
De los pintores renacentistas de frescos a los novelistas gráficos contemporáneos, la capacidad de dibujar figuras vestidas de la imaginación siempre ha sido crucial para los artistas – y excepcionalmente difícil de alcanzar. Con más de 220 ilustraciones, The Art of Drawing Folds: An Illustrator’s Guide to Drawing the Clothed Figure revela la lógica y los patrones en pliegues, permitiendo al lector predecir más fácilmente el comportamiento del paño al crear pliegues en sus propios dibujos y pinturas.

Al abordar los pliegues de ropa sistemáticamente, el autor proporciona un enfoque claro y conciso del análisis, clasificación y visualización de pliegues convincentemente naturalistas. Partiendo de la naturaleza de la tela y su geometría, este libro explora metódicamente las razones de la conducta plegable basada en la construcción de la ropa y las formas y acciones de la figura humana. Una guía esencial y referencia para animadores, ilustradores, artistas de guión gráfico, artistas de cómics, modeladores 3D, escultores, diseñadores de moda y estudiantes, El arte de dibujar Folds simplifica uno de los aspectos más complejos e importantes de dibujar la figura vestida.

title: No Plastic Sleeves: Portfolio and Self-Promotion Guide for Photographers and Designers, 2nd Edition
description:
A polished and professional portfolio—including both print pieces and an online presence—is more important than ever for photographers and other creative professionals to make a great first impression and secure employment. This new edition of No Plastic Sleeves has been updated to address all facets of portfolio production, with a special focus on self-promotion and new information about blogs and social media’s role in the process. Objectively evaluate and edit your work

Design a tailor-made portfolio book

Develop a comprehensive online portfolio

Utilize social media and self-promotion strategies

title: Python Web Development with Django®
description:
Using the simple, robust, Python-based Django framework, you can build powerful Web solutions with remarkably few lines of code. In Python Web Development with Django®, three experienced Django and Python developers cover all the techniques, tools, and concepts you need to make the most of Django 1.0, including all the major features of the new release.

The authors teach Django through in-depth explanations, plus provide extensive sample code supported with images and line-by-line explanations. You’ll discover how Django leverages Python’s development speed and flexibility to help you solve a wide spectrum of Web development problems and learn Django best practices covered nowhere else. You’ll build your first Django application in just minutes and deepen your real-world skills through start-to-finish application projects including

Simple Web log (blog)

Online photo gallery

Simple content management system

Ajax-powered live blogger

Online source code sharing/syntax highlighting tool

How to run your Django applications on the Google App Engine

This complete guide starts by introducing Python, Django, and Web development concepts, then dives into the Django framework, providing a deep understanding of its major components (models, views, templates), and how they come together to form complete Web applications. After a discussion of four independent working Django applications, coverage turns to advanced topics, such as caching, extending the template system, syndication, admin customization, and testing. Valuable reference appendices cover using the command-line, installing and configuring Django, development tools, exploring existing Django applications, the Google App Engine, and how to get more involved with the Django community.

title: #MakeoverMonday
description:
Explore different perspectives and approaches to create more effective visualizations

#MakeoverMonday offers inspiration and a giant dose of perspective for those who communicate data. Originally a small project in the data visualization community, #MakeoverMonday features a weekly chart or graph and a dataset that community members reimagine in order to make it more effective. The results have been astounding; hundreds of people have contributed thousands of makeovers, perfectly illustrating the highly variable nature of data visualization. Different takes on the same data showed a wide variation of theme, focus, content, and design, with side-by-side comparisons throwing more- and less-effective techniques into sharp relief.

This book is an extension of that project, featuring a variety of makeovers that showcase various approaches to data communication and a focus on the analytical, design and storytelling skills that have been developed through #MakeoverMonday. Paging through the makeovers ignites immediate inspiration for your own work, provides insight into different perspectives, and highlights the techniques that truly make an impact.

Explore the many approaches to visual data communication
Think beyond the data and consider audience, stakeholders, and message
Design your graphs to be intuitive and more communicative
Assess the impact of layout, color, font, chart type, and other design choices

Creating visual representation of complex datasets is tricky. There’s the mandate to include all relevant data in a clean, readable format that best illustrates what the data is saying—but there is also the designer’s impetus to showcase a command of the complexity and create multidimensional visualizations that “look cool.” #MakeoverMonday shows you the many ways to walk the line between simple reporting and design artistry to create exactly the visualization the situation requires.
translatedDescription:
Explore diferentes perspectivas y enfoques para crear visualizaciones más eficaces

#MakeoverMonday ofrece inspiración y una dosis gigante de perspectiva para aquellos que comunican datos. Originalmente un pequeño proyecto en la comunidad de visualización de datos, #MakeoverMonday cuenta con un gráfico semanal y un conjunto de datos que los miembros de la comunidad reimagine para hacerlo más eficaz. Los resultados han sido asombrosos; cientos de personas han contribuido a miles de cambio de imagen, lo que ilustra perfectamente la naturaleza altamente variable de la visualización de datos. Diferentes tomas en los mismos datos mostraron una amplia variación de tema, enfoque, contenido y diseño, con comparaciones de lado a lado lanzando técnicas más y menos eficaces en el alivio agudo.

Este libro es una extensión de ese proyecto, con una variedad de maquillajes que muestran diversos enfoques de la comunicación de datos y un enfoque en las habilidades analíticas, de diseño y de narración que se han desarrollado a través de #MakeoverMonday. Paging through the makeovers ignites immediate inspiration for your own work, provides insight into different perspectives, and highlights the techniques that truly make an impact.

Explore los muchos enfoques de la comunicación visual de datos
Piensa más allá de los datos y considera audiencia, actores y mensajes
Diseña tus gráficos para ser intuitivo y más comunicativo
Evaluar el impacto del diseño, el color, la fuente, el tipo de gráfico y otras opciones de diseño

Crear representación visual de conjuntos de datos complejos es difícil. Hay el mandato de incluir todos los datos relevantes en un formato limpio y legible que mejor ilustra lo que dicen los datos, pero también hay el impulso del diseñador para mostrar un comando de la complejidad y crear visualizaciones multidimensionales que “miran frescos”. #MakeoverMonday le muestra las muchas maneras de caminar la línea entre reportaje simple y artista de diseño para crear exactamente la visualización que la situación requiere.

title: Dream Worlds: Production Design for Animation
description: A truly unique visual delight offering insight into the development of animation classics like Bambi, Beauty and the Beast, The Lion King, Lilo and Stitch as well as a tantalizing examination of unfinished Disney projects.
translatedDescription: Un deleite visual verdaderamente único que ofrece información sobre el desarrollo de los clásicos de animación como Bambi, Belleza y la Bestia, El Rey León, Lilo y Stitch, así como un examen tentador de proyectos de Disney inacabados.

title: The Art of Black and White Photography, 2nd Edition
description: Over the last few years, most books on photography have been focused on the new breed of cameras and how to master the digital imaging workflow. In The Art of Black and White Photography, author and photographer Torsten Andreas Hoffmann takes a different approach, focusing on image composition and image capture, with an emphasis on the creative aspects of black and white photography rather than on the digital workflow.After introducing the ground rules of composition, Hoffmann illustrates their applications with his own stunning black and white images that cover various photographic genres, including architecture, street photography, portraiture, and surreal photography. Also discussed are the elements of a "photographic language"', which distinguishes creative photography from random shooting. Finally, you will learn valuable post-processing techniques, mostly using Photoshop, that emphasize the functions necessary for creating outstanding black and white images.This second edition has been updated to include Photoshop CS5, as well as brand new images, content, and a revised layout.
translatedDescription: En los últimos años, la mayoría de los libros sobre fotografía se han centrado en la nueva raza de cámaras y en cómo dominar el flujo de trabajo de imagen digital. En The Art of Black and White Photography, el autor y fotógrafo Torsten Andreas Hoffmann toma un enfoque diferente, centrándose en la composición de la imagen y la captura de la imagen, con énfasis en los aspectos creativos de la fotografía blanca y negra en lugar de en el flujo de trabajo digital. Después de introducir las reglas básicas de composición, Hoffmann ilustra sus aplicaciones con sus propias impresionantes imágenes en blanco y negro que cubren diversos géneros fotográficos, incluyendo arquitectura, fotografía callejera, retrato y fotografía surrealista. También se discuten los elementos de un "lengua fotográfica" que distingue la fotografía creativa del tiroteo al azar. Finalmente, usted aprenderá valiosas técnicas de post-procesamiento, principalmente utilizando Photoshop, que enfatizan las funciones necesarias para crear imágenes blancas y negras sobresalientes. Esta segunda edición ha sido actualizada para incluir Photoshop CS5, así como nuevas imágenes, contenidos y un diseño revisado.

title: Adobe® Target Classroom in a Book®
description: Marketers engaged in managing a modern website must quickly determine and deliver the most relevant, personalized experiences at each touchpoint across their digital properties for an often diverse visitor population. The Adobe Target solution (one component of the Adobe Digital Marketing Cloud) provides an optimization solution with intuitive but sophisticated capabilities that leads marketers through the essential steps of optimizing and personalizing their content, clearly showing them which content increases conversion lift and revenue. In Adobe Target Classroom in a Book, seasoned Target veteran Brian Hawkins introduces new users to the basic concepts of website optimization, including A/B testing, audience targeting, segmentation, and recommendation. Brian goes on to provide a thorough introduction to the Adobe Target solution, with lessons on setting up customer offers, testing campaigns, custom segmentation, multivariate test, and reporting. It includes best practices as well as countless tips and techniques to help you become more productive with the software. You can follow the book from start to finish or choose only those lessons that interest you. Classroom in a Book®, the best-selling series of hands-on software training workbooks, helps you learn the features of Adobe software quickly and easily. Classroom in a Book offers what no other book or training program does–an official training series from Adobe Systems Incorporated, developed with the support of Adobe product experts.
translatedDescription: Los vendedores que se dedican a gestionar un sitio web moderno deben determinar y ofrecer rápidamente las experiencias más relevantes y personalizadas en cada punto de contacto a través de sus propiedades digitales para una población de visitantes a menudo diversa. La solución Adobe Target (un componente de Adobe Digital Marketing Cloud) ofrece una solución de optimización con capacidades intuitivas pero sofisticadas que conduce a los marketers a través de los pasos esenciales de optimizar y personalizar su contenido, mostrándoles claramente qué contenido aumenta la elevación de conversión y los ingresos. En Adobe Target Classroom in a Book, el veterano de Target Brian Hawkins presenta nuevos usuarios a los conceptos básicos de optimización del sitio web, incluyendo pruebas A/B, segmentación y recomendación. Brian va a proporcionar una introducción completa a la solución Adobe Target, con lecciones sobre la creación de ofertas de clientes, campañas de pruebas, segmentación personalizada, prueba multivariada y reportaje. Incluye las mejores prácticas, así como innumerables consejos y técnicas para ayudarle a ser más productivo con el software. Puedes seguir el libro de principio a fin o elegir sólo las lecciones que te interesan. Aula en un Book®, la mejor serie de manuales de entrenamiento de software, le ayuda a aprender las características del software de Adobe de forma rápida y sencilla. Classroom in a Book ofrece lo que ningún otro programa de libro o entrenamiento hace – una serie oficial de capacitación de Adobe Systems Incorporated, desarrollada con el apoyo de expertos en productos de Adobe.

title: Mastering Windows Network Forensics and Investigation, 2nd Edition
description:
An authoritative guide to investigating high-technology crimes

Internet crime is seemingly ever on the rise, making the need for a comprehensive resource on how to investigate these crimes even more dire. This professional-level book--aimed at law enforcement personnel, prosecutors, and corporate investigators--provides you with the training you need in order to acquire the sophisticated skills and software solutions to stay one step ahead of computer criminals.

Specifies the techniques needed to investigate, analyze, and document a criminal act on a Windows computer or network

Places a special emphasis on how to thoroughly investigate criminal activity and now just perform the initial response

Walks you through ways to present technically complicated material in simple terms that will hold up in court

Features content fully updated for Windows Server 2008 R2 and Windows 7

Covers the emerging field of Windows Mobile forensics

Also included is a classroom support package to ensure academic adoption, Mastering Windows Network Forensics and Investigation, 2nd Edition offers help for investigating high-technology crimes.
translatedDescription:
Guía autorizada para investigar delitos de alta tecnología

La delincuencia en Internet parece estar en aumento, lo que hace que la necesidad de un recurso amplio sobre la forma de investigar estos delitos sea aún más grave. Este libro de nivel profesional, dirigido por el personal de las fuerzas del orden, los fiscales y los investigadores corporativos, le proporciona la formación que necesita para adquirir las habilidades y soluciones de software sofisticadas para mantenerse un paso por delante de los delincuentes informáticos.

Especifica las técnicas necesarias para investigar, analizar y documentar un acto criminal en un ordenador o red Windows

Pone especial énfasis en cómo investigar a fondo la actividad delictiva y ahora simplemente realizar la respuesta inicial

Camina a través de maneras de presentar material técnicamente complicado en términos simples que se mantendrá en la corte

Características de contenido completamente actualizado para Windows Server 2008 R2 y Windows 7

Cubre el campo emergente de Windows Mobile forenses

También está incluido un paquete de soporte para aulas para asegurar la adopción académica, Mastering Windows Network Forensics and Investigation, 2nd Edition ofrece ayuda para investigar crímenes de alta tecnología.

title: Scoring to Picture in Logic Pro
description:
"Scoring to Picture in Logic Pro" is your comprehensive guide to learning the art and science of scoring music for film, TV, and multimedia projects using Logic Pro. With step-by-step instructions and insights from industry practices, this book equips you to creatively merge music with visuals, elevate your technical expertise, and kickstart your career in scoring.

What this Book will help me do

Master the terminology and workflows necessary for scoring to picture.
Effectively utilize Logic Pro features for composition and synchronization.
Learn to set up and sync movie files to music tracks in Logic Pro.
Understand how to communicate musical ideas with industry professionals.
Develop the skills to build a successful career as a multimedia composer.

Author(s)

Prof. Chris Piorkowski is a skilled film composer and educator with extensive experience in using Logic Pro for multimedia projects. Having worked with major industry players, he brings a rich understanding of both the creative and technical aspects of film scoring. Prof. Piorkowski is passionate about teaching and has designed this book to empower the next generation of composers with actionable skills and confidence.

Who is it for?

This book is designed for aspiring film and multimedia composers looking to break into the industry, as well as seasoned musicians seeking to refine their techniques within Logic Pro. If you're a music supervisor, editor, or orchestrator aiming to deepen your understanding of scoring to picture, this book will provide valuable guidance. Basic knowledge of Logic Pro and music theory is recommended.
translatedDescription:
"Scoring to Picture in Logic Pro" es su guía integral para aprender el arte y la ciencia de anotar música para proyectos de cine, TV y multimedia usando Logic Pro. Con instrucciones y percepciones paso a paso de las prácticas de la industria, este libro te capacita para fusionar creativamente la música con visuales, elevar tu experiencia técnica y comenzar tu carrera en la puntuación.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Domine la terminología y los flujos de trabajo necesarios para marcar a la imagen.
Utilizar eficazmente las funciones Logic Pro para la composición y sincronización.
Aprende a configurar y sincronizar archivos de películas a canciones de música en Logic Pro.
Entender cómo comunicar ideas musicales con profesionales de la industria.
Desarrollar las habilidades para construir una carrera exitosa como compositor multimedia.

Autor(s)

Prof. Chris Piorkowski es un experto compositor de películas y educador con amplia experiencia en el uso de Logic Pro para proyectos multimedia. Habiendo trabajado con los principales jugadores de la industria, aporta una rica comprensión de los aspectos creativos y técnicos de la puntuación cinematográfica. Prof. Piorkowski es apasionado por la enseñanza y ha diseñado este libro para empoderar a la próxima generación de compositores con habilidades de acción y confianza.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro está diseñado para aspirantes a compositores de cine y multimedia que buscan entrar en la industria, así como músicos experimentados que buscan refinar sus técnicas dentro de Logic Pro. Si usted es un supervisor de música, editor o orquestador que pretende profundizar su comprensión de la puntuación a la imagen, este libro proporcionará una valiosa guía. Se recomienda el conocimiento básico de Logic Pro y la teoría musical.

title: Share Your Joy
description: Share Your Joy embraces shareable and mixed-media art through projects, prompts, and stories that invite you to explore your creativity and have fun with art supplies.
translatedDescription: Comparte Tu alegría abarca el arte compartido y mediático a través de proyectos, consejos e historias que te invitan a explorar tu creatividad y divertirte con suministros de arte.

title: Designing Digital Products for Kids: Deliver User Experiences That Delight Kids, Parents, and Teachers
description:
Childhood learning is now more screen-based than ever before, and app developers are flocking in droves to this lucrative and exciting market. The younger generation deserves the best, and growing up in a digital world has made them discerning and demanding customers. Creating a valuable user experience for a child is as complex and involved as when designing a typical app for an adult, if not more, and Designing Digital Products for Kids is here to be your guide.

Author and designer Rubens Cantuni recognizes the societal importance of a high-quality and ethical app experience for children. There is room for significant improvement in this space, and Cantuni helps you optimize it. Designing Digital Products for Kids walks hopeful developers through digital product design—including research, concept, design, release, marketing, testing, analyzing, and iterating—all while aiming to build specifically for children.

Industry experts and their real-world advice are showcased in this book, along with careful advice for the ethics that go along with this unique market. These tips include complex needs regarding mental development, accessibility, conscious screen time limits, and content sensitivity. Children, parents, and teachers alike are hungry for more thoughtful players in the kids’ app space, and Designing Digital Products for Kids is your ticket to successfully developing and educating for the future. 

What You Will Learn
Design platforms specifically for children, to entertain and educate them
Work with a complex audience of parents, teachers and kids
Understand how different monetization strategies work in this industry and why 
Who This Book Is For
User experience designers, UI designers, product owners, teachers and educators, startup founders. The range oftopics is so wide that anyone interested or involved in digital products could find something interesting to learn.
translatedDescription:
El aprendizaje infantil es ahora más basado en la pantalla que nunca antes, y los desarrolladores de aplicaciones se están adentrando en las unidades a este mercado lucrativo y emocionante. La generación más joven merece lo mejor, y crecer en un mundo digital los ha hecho clientes exigentes y exigentes. Crear una valiosa experiencia de usuario para un niño es tan compleja e implicada como al diseñar una aplicación típica para un adulto, si no más, y diseñar productos digitales para niños está aquí para ser su guía.

Autor y diseñador Rubens Cantuni reconoce la importancia social de una experiencia de aplicación de alta calidad y ética para los niños. Hay margen para una mejora significativa en este espacio, y Cantuni le ayuda a optimizarlo. Diseñar productos digitales para niños camina desarrolladores esperanzadores a través del diseño de productos digitales, incluyendo investigación, concepto, diseño, liberación, marketing, pruebas, análisis y iteración, todo ello mientras se pretende construir específicamente para los niños.

Los expertos de la industria y sus consejos del mundo real se muestran en este libro, junto con consejos cuidadosos para la ética que van junto con este mercado único. Estos consejos incluyen necesidades complejas en materia de desarrollo mental, accesibilidad, límites de tiempo de pantalla conscientes y sensibilidad al contenido. Los niños, padres y maestros por igual tienen hambre para jugadores más reflexivos en el espacio de aplicaciones de los niños, y Designing Digital Products for Kids es su boleto para desarrollar y educar con éxito para el futuro.

Qué aprenderás
Plataformas de diseño específicamente para niños, para entretenerlos y educarlos
Trabajar con un público complejo de padres, maestros y niños
Entender cómo funcionan las diferentes estrategias de monetización en esta industria y por qué
Quién es este libro
Diseñadores de experiencia de usuario, diseñadores de UI, propietarios de productos, maestros y educadores, fundadores de startups. La gama de lotopía es tan amplia que cualquiera interesado o involucrado en productos digitales podría encontrar algo interesante para aprender.

title: Podcast Academy: The Business Podcasting Book
description:
Exclusive Podcast Academy training now available in a book!

Podcast Academy, the leader in audio/video podcast and new media education, brings you their first book, Podcast Academy: The Business Podcasting Book, based on their seminars. Written by industry experts, this book brings you practical experience that you can apply to your own business. It covers planning, content creation, legal considerations, branding, marketing, advertising, monetization, and much more. The authors and contributors have been behind many of the earliest corporate podcasts and share their knowledge, success, and real-world experience with you.

Podcasting is changing the way organizations are communicating with their customers, prospects and the media. It is an essential new medium for any company looking to extend their communications outreach, and expand their brand awareness. This applies for companies, organizations, charities, schools and groups that range in size from small to Fortune 500 enterprises. If you are thinking about podcasting as a medium for your organization, The Business Podcasting Book will give you a solid understanding of how to create your own company's voice, measure your efforts and maximize your opportunity. Implement your podcasting strategy now!
translatedDescription:
Exclusiva Academia Podcast ahora disponible en un libro!

Podcast Academy, líder en audio/video podcast y nueva educación mediática, le trae su primer libro, Podcast Academy: The Business Podcasting Book, basado en sus seminarios. Escrito por expertos de la industria, este libro te trae experiencia práctica que puedes aplicar a tu propio negocio. Cubre la planificación, creación de contenidos, consideraciones legales, marca, marketing, publicidad, monetización y mucho más. Los autores y colaboradores han estado detrás de muchos de los primeros podcasts corporativos y comparten su conocimiento, éxito y experiencia en el mundo real contigo.

Podcasting está cambiando la forma en que las organizaciones se comunican con sus clientes, perspectivas y medios de comunicación. Es un nuevo medio esencial para cualquier empresa que desee ampliar su extensión de comunicaciones y ampliar su conciencia de marca. Esto se aplica para empresas, organizaciones, organizaciones benéficas, escuelas y grupos que van desde pequeñas hasta Fortune 500 empresas. Si usted está pensando en podcasting como un medio para su organización, The Business Podcasting Book le dará una sólida comprensión de cómo crear la voz de su propia empresa, medir sus esfuerzos y maximizar su oportunidad. Implemente su estrategia de podcasting ahora!

title: Intertwingled
description: A spirited tour of information architecture, user experience, and systems thinking that reveals how everything is connected from code to culture.
translatedDescription: Un recorrido espírita de arquitectura de la información, experiencia de usuario y sistemas que revela cómo todo está conectado de código a cultura.

title: Home Studio Setup
description: Whether you have a ton of equipment or just the basic gear this book offers an all you need to know to setting up, running and getting great sound from a project studio. In three parts Harris walks you thought Acoustics, Equipment and Recording Technique. From the basics of acoustic treatment to techniques to solve problems specific to your room, and from offering explanations and information of equipment to how to record and create a great mix. In no time you'll be recording, producing great music in your very own studio.
translatedDescription: Ya sea que tenga una tonelada de equipo o sólo el equipo básico de este libro ofrece todo lo que necesita saber para configurar, correr y obtener un gran sonido de un estudio de proyecto. En tres partes Harris camina usted pensó Acústica, Equipo y Técnica de Grabación. Desde los fundamentos del tratamiento acústico hasta técnicas para resolver problemas específicos de su habitación, y desde ofrecer explicaciones e información de equipo a cómo grabar y crear una gran mezcla. En ningún momento vas a grabar, produciendo gran música en tu propio estudio.

title: The Fujifilm X100VI
description:
Learn all you need to master your Fuji X100VI camera!

This book is a quick and effective guide to photography with the X100VI, Fujifilm's iconic premium compact camera. Renowned Fuji "X-Pert" Rico Pfirstinger has compiled 130 useful tips and tricks and lots of exclusive information that you won't find anywhere else. It will help you understand and use the X100VI in a way that elevates your photography and gets you the best results without delay. After a brief overview of the camera’s basic functions, Rico cuts to the chase and provides a plethora of tips and practical insights that go way beyond the user’s manual. Fujifilm's legendary film simulations and JPEG settings are also covered in detail to ensure that you can achieve fantastic images straight out of the camera.

What’s inside:

• Master the hybrid autofocus system with auto/manual focus, face detection and object detection

• Make the most of the ISO-less sensor and expose optimally in all situations, at all times

• Shoot with film simulations and create stylish analog looks

• Use the built-in and external ND filters for long exposures

• Configure function buttons, custom user settings and menu shortcuts for quick and easy access

• Learn how to convert RAWs in-camera for optimal results

• Use the built-in flash or external flash units

• Use accessories such as filters, adapters and converter lenses properly–and much more
translatedDescription:
¡Aprenda todo lo que necesita para dominar su cámara Fuji X100VI!

Este libro es una guía rápida y eficaz de la fotografía con la X100VI, la icónica cámara compacta premium de Fujifilm. Renombrado Fuji "X-Pert" Rico Pfirstinger ha compilado 130 consejos y trucos útiles y mucha información exclusiva que no encontrará en ningún otro lugar. Le ayudará a entender y utilizar el X100VI de una manera que eleva su fotografía y le consigue los mejores resultados sin demora. Después de una breve visión general de las funciones básicas de la cámara, Rico corta a la persecución y proporciona una plétora de consejos y ideas prácticas que van mucho más allá del manual del usuario. Las legendarias simulaciones de película de Fujifilm y la configuración de JPEG también están cubiertas en detalle para asegurar que usted pueda lograr fantásticas imágenes directamente de la cámara.

Lo que hay dentro:

• Dominar el sistema híbrido de autofocus con enfoque automático/manual, detección facial y detección de objetos

• Aproveche al máximo el sensor sin ISO y exponga de forma óptima en todas las situaciones, en todo momento

• Disparar con simulaciones de película y crear elegantes looks analógicos

• Use los filtros ND incorporados y externos para exposiciones largas

• Configurar botones de función, ajustes de usuario personalizados y atajos de menú para un acceso rápido y fácil

• Aprender a convertir RAWs en cámara para obtener resultados óptimos

• Utilice las unidades de flash integradas o externas

• Use accesorios como filtros, adaptadores y lentes convertidores adecuadamente – y mucho más

title: The Art of Social Selling
description: Social media platforms such as Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, and Pinterest are changing the way consumers make purchasing decisions . . . and tapping into these online communities has become a necessary part of any integrated sales strategy. Citing enlightening research and real-world examples, this smart, practical guide presents readers with a detailed methodology for growing sales and expanding their customer base using social media. Readers will learn how to: • Use content and conversations to build online relationships that transition to sales• Execute realistic sales strategies for each of the major social media platforms• Spot social media trends that may influence future buying behaviors• Sell online in B2B and B2C environments• Turn social shares (likes, favorites, +1s) into social sales• Set tangible goals• Use online tools and analytics to track social influencers and identify relevant conversations as they are happening Complete with a chapter dedicated to capturing mobile sales—a segment poised to explode as the adoption of smartphones and tablets grows—The Art of Social Selling is essential reading for every sales professional.
translatedDescription: Las plataformas de redes sociales como Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn y Pinterest están cambiando la forma en que los consumidores toman decisiones de compra . . y tocando en estas comunidades en línea se ha convertido en una parte necesaria de cualquier estrategia de ventas integrada. Citando investigación esclarecedora y ejemplos reales, esta guía inteligente y práctica presenta a los lectores una metodología detallada para el crecimiento de las ventas y la ampliación de su base de clientes utilizando redes sociales. Los lectores aprenderán cómo: • Usar contenido y conversaciones para crear relaciones en línea que la transición a las ventas• Ejecutar estrategias de ventas realistas para cada una de las principales plataformas de redes sociales• Tendencias de las redes sociales que pueden influir en futuros comportamientos de compra• Vender en línea en entornos B2B y B2C• Convertir acciones sociales (como, favoritos, +1s) en ventas sociales• Establecer objetivos tangibles• Utilice herramientas y análisis en línea para rastrear a los influencers sociales e identificar conversaciones relevantes mientras están ocurriendo Completamente con un capítulo dedicado a capturar ventas móviles, un segmento que se puede explotar a medida que crece la adopción de teléfonos inteligentes y tabletas, el arte de la venta social es la lectura esencial para cada profesional de ventas.

title: Lettering
description: Using a combination of explanatory text, step-by-step photographs, and classic and contemporary examples, this unique survey brings together over 130 processes involved in creating lettering and applying it to surfaces. Included are hand-drawn lettering techniques (from sign writing to tattooing); dimensional lettering (hand engraving to laser cutting); typesetting (from letterpress to lettering in food); printing (Letraset to printing on bank notes); lettering on textiles (embroidery to flag-making); and illuminated type (neon signage to holography). Any designer wishing either to create lettering themselves or to commission work from external sources can use the book to look up the technical needs and processes for a particular task, so instantly expanding their repertoire of typographic media.
translatedDescription: Usando una combinación de texto explicativo, fotografías paso a paso y ejemplos clásicos y contemporáneos, esta encuesta única reúne más de 130 procesos involucrados en la creación de letras y su aplicación a superficies. Se incluyen técnicas de letras dibujadas a mano (desde la escritura de firmas hasta el tatuaje); letras dimensionales (grabado a mano a corte láser); tipografía (desde la letra a la letra en la comida); impresión (Letraset a la impresión en notas bancarias); letras en textiles (embroidery a la elaboración de bandera); y tipo iluminado (señal a holografía). Cualquier diseñador que desee crear cartas o encargar trabajos de fuentes externas puede utilizar el libro para buscar las necesidades y procesos técnicos para una tarea particular, así que al instante se expande su repertorio de medios tipográficos.

title: Practical DevOps
description:
Practical DevOps offers a comprehensive insight into the principles and practices of DevOps. This book walks you through the DevOps methodology, starting with its foundations, and demonstrates its application in real-world IT environments. With practical examples and step-by-step guidance, you'll learn to enhance collaboration, automate workflows, and deliver software efficiently.

What this Book will help me do

Build a solid understanding of DevOps and its role in modern software delivery.
Learn how to efficiently store and manage code using version control systems like Git.
Master automated testing and continuous integration using tools like Jenkins.
Implement automated deployment strategies using tools like Ansible and Puppet.
Monitor and maintain code health with tools like Nagios and Munin.

Author(s)

Joakim Verona is a seasoned IT professional and DevOps expert with years of experience in software development and IT infrastructure. Passionate about improving efficiency in software delivery, Joakim has authored several technical books on DevOps and related fields. He approaches writing with a focus on clarity, practicality, and real-world application, ensuring readers gain actionable skills.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for developers, system administrators, and IT professionals aiming to enhance their knowledge of DevOps practices. Whether you are new to DevOps or looking to deepen your skills, this guide provides practical insights and techniques. It's especially useful for those seeking to improve collaboration and efficiency in their teams. Begin your DevOps journey or refine your expertise with this practical handbook.
translatedDescription:
Practical DevOps ofrece una visión completa de los principios y prácticas de DevOps. Este libro te lleva a través de la metodología DevOps, empezando por sus bases, y demuestra su aplicación en entornos de TI del mundo real. Con ejemplos prácticos y guía paso a paso, aprenderás a mejorar la colaboración, automatizar los flujos de trabajo y entregar el software de manera eficiente.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Construir una comprensión sólida de DevOps y su papel en la entrega de software moderno.
Aprenda a almacenar y gestionar de manera eficiente código utilizando sistemas de control de versiones como Git.
Prueba automatizada y integración continua utilizando herramientas como Jenkins.
Implementar estrategias de implementación automatizadas utilizando herramientas como Ansible y Puppet.
Monitorear y mantener la salud de código con herramientas como Nagios y Munin.

Autor(s)

Joakim Verona es un experimentado profesional de TI y experto en DevOps con años de experiencia en desarrollo de software e infraestructura de TI. Apasionado por mejorar la eficiencia en la entrega de software, Joakim ha autorizado varios libros técnicos sobre DevOps y campos relacionados. Se acerca a escribir con un enfoque en la claridad, la practicidad y la aplicación del mundo real, asegurando que los lectores obtengan habilidades prácticas.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para desarrolladores, administradores de sistemas y profesionales de TI que buscan mejorar su conocimiento de las prácticas de DevOps. Tanto si eres nuevo en DevOps como si buscas profundizar tus habilidades, esta guía proporciona información práctica y técnicas. Es especialmente útil para aquellos que buscan mejorar la colaboración y eficiencia en sus equipos. Comience su viaje DevOps o refina su experiencia con este práctico manual.

title: Virtual Natives
description:
The eclipse of Digital Natives and the dawn of virtual culture—how Gen A, Z are radically redefining the future of work, play, economics, and social life.

We’re living through what is arguably one of the most exciting, confusing, and powerful social moments in the history of humanity, the shift from the Digital Age to the Virtual Age. This shift is being driven by technology, and the people who are leading it are the ones who know it best: the Virtual Natives. This book will introduce you to the Virtual Native cohort and mindset, decipher their socio-cultural and economic experiences, and unpack their expectations of companies looking to engage, market, or employ them.

In this book, we explore:

How Virtual Natives are deploying the new technologies driving the virtualized world
How relationships and work habits are being virtualized
Identify ten main Virtual Native-led behaviors that are upending work and culture
How Virtual Natives are evolving their expertise into a full-blown economy

This is nothing short of a cultural revolution. Virtual Natives are the driving force behind a seismic change that is redefining the world through technology and virtual worlds: this book tells you how they are navigating everything from AI to Augmented and virtual reality, gaming, blockchain and Web3 in easy, accessible language.

To understand the future, read Virtual Natives.
translatedDescription:
El eclipse de los nativos digitales y el amanecer de la cultura virtual — cómo Gen A, Z están redefiniendo radicalmente el futuro del trabajo, el juego, la economía y la vida social.

Vivimos a través de lo que es posiblemente uno de los momentos sociales más emocionantes, confusos y poderosos de la historia de la humanidad, el cambio de la Era Digital a la Era Virtual. Este cambio está siendo impulsado por la tecnología, y las personas que la dirigen son las que lo conocen mejor: los nativos virtuales. Este libro te presentará a la cohorte y mentalidad nativa virtual, descifrar sus experiencias socioculturales y económicas, y desembalaje sus expectativas de empresas que buscan involucrarse, comercializar o emplearlas.

En este libro, exploramos:

Cómo los nativos virtuales están implementando las nuevas tecnologías que impulsan el mundo virtualizado
Cómo se virtualizan las relaciones y los hábitos de trabajo
Identificar diez conductas principales dirigidas por nativos que están usando trabajo y cultura
Cómo los nativos virtuales están evolucionando su experiencia en una economía de bloque completo

Esto no es nada menos que una revolución cultural. Los nativos virtuales son la fuerza motriz detrás de un cambio sísmico que está redefiniendo el mundo a través de la tecnología y los mundos virtuales: este libro te dice cómo están navegando todo de AI a la realidad aumentada y virtual, juegos, blockchain y Web3 en lenguaje fácil y accesible.

Para entender el futuro, lea Virtual Natives.

title: Art of Basic Drawing
description: This compilation of some of our most popular How to Draw and Paint and Artist's Library series titles gives artists the perfect introduction to the basics of drawing. The Art of Basic Drawing contains fundamental information about tools and techniques, as well as a number of inspiring step-by-step lessons. With instruction and advice from five different accomplished artists, this book showcases a range of styles for beginners to imitate. And with simple, easy-to-follow lessons that cover a variety of subject matter-from engaging still lifes and beautiful landscapes to realistic people and adorable animals-there is something for everyone inside. With the inspiring material in this comprehensive reference book, you’ll soon discover how exciting the world of drawing can be!
translatedDescription: Esta recopilación de algunos de nuestros títulos más populares de la serie How to Draw and Paint and Artist's Library ofrece a los artistas la introducción perfecta a los fundamentos del dibujo. El Arte de Dibujo Básico contiene información fundamental sobre herramientas y técnicas, así como una serie de lecciones inspiradoras paso a paso. Con la instrucción y el consejo de cinco artistas diferentes logrados, este libro muestra una gama de estilos para los principiantes a imitar.
